title.zh: 卷一百五十八 志第一百十一 選舉四
title.en: Volume 158 Treatises 111: Selection and appointment of Officials 4
title.raw: 卷一百五十八 志第一百十一 選舉四 Volume 158 Treatises 111: Selection and appointment of Officials 4

sentences.zh: 選舉四

translations.literal: Selection and Appointment 4
translations.idiomatic: Selection and Appointment of Officials, Part Four

sentences.zh: （銓法上）〉

translations.literal: (On the Appraisal Law, Part One)
translations.idiomatic: (On the Appraisal Law, Part One)

sentences.zh: 太祖設官分職，多襲五代之製，稍損益之。

translations.literal: Taizu established offices and divided duties, mostly following the Five Dynasties system, with slight additions and reductions.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu established offices and apportioned duties, he largely followed the institutions of the Five Dynasties, modifying them only here and there.

sentences.zh: 凡入仕，有貢舉、奏蔭、攝署、流外、從軍五等。

translations.literal: For all entering office, there were five categories: presented through examination, memorialized yin privilege, provisional appointment, outside-the-stream, and from military service.
translations.idiomatic: Entry into office fell into five routes: examination candidacy, hereditary privilege by memorial, provisional appointment, service outside the regular stream, and military service.

sentences.zh: 吏部銓惟注擬州縣官、幕職，兩京諸司六品以下官皆無選；

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel's selection commission only assigned prefectural and county officials and staff posts; officials of the sixth rank and below in the two capitals and various bureaus had no selection through it;
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel's appraisal commission assigned only prefectural, county, and secretariat posts; for officials of the sixth rank and below in the two capitals and the various ministries, it exercised no selection authority;

sentences.zh: 文臣少卿、監以上中書主之，京朝官則審官院主之；

translations.literal: for civil officials from vice director and commissioner upward, the Secretariat presided; for capital officials, the Office for Review of Appointments presided;
translations.idiomatic: civil officials from vice director and commissioner upward were handled by the Secretariat, while capital officials fell to the Office for Review of Appointments;

sentences.zh: 武臣刺史、副率以上內職，樞密院主之，使臣則三班院主之。

translations.literal: for military officials from prefect and deputy commander-in-chief upward and inner-service posts, the Bureau of Military Affairs presided; for envoy-officials, the Third-Class Hall presided.
translations.idiomatic: military officials from prefect and deputy commander-in-chief upward and inner-service posts were handled by the Bureau of Military Affairs, while envoy-officials were handled by the Third-Class Hall.

sentences.zh: 其後，典選之職分為四：文選曰審官東院，曰流內銓，武選曰審官西院，曰三班院。

translations.literal: Thereafter, the duties of managing selection were divided into four: for civil selection, the Eastern Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments and the Within-the-Stream Selection; for military selection, the Western Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments and the Third-Class Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Later the duties of managing selection were split four ways: civil selection went to the Eastern Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments and to the Within-the-Stream Selection; military selection went to the Western Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments and to the Third-Class Hall.

sentences.zh: 元豐定制而後，銓注之法，悉歸選部：以審官東院為尚書左選，流內銓為侍郎左選，審官西院為尚書右選，三班院為侍郎右選，於是吏部有四選之法。

translations.literal: After the Yuanfeng institutional reforms, the methods of appraisal assignment all returned to the Selection Department: the Eastern Hall became the Left Selection of the Ministry Director, the Within-the-Stream Selection became the Left Selection of the Vice Director, the Western Hall became the Right Selection of the Ministry Director, and the Third-Class Hall became the Right Selection of the Vice Director; thus the Ministry of Personnel had the four-selection system.
translations.idiomatic: After the Yuanfeng reforms fixed the institutions, appraisal and assignment were wholly reunited under the Selection Department: the Eastern Hall became the Ministry Director's Left Selection, the Within-the-Stream Selection the Vice Director's Left Selection, the Western Hall the Ministry Director's Right Selection, and the Third-Class Hall the Vice Director's Right Selection—giving the Ministry of Personnel its fourfold selection law.

sentences.zh: 文臣寄祿官自朝議大夫、職事官自大理正以下，非中書省敕授者，歸尚書左選；

translations.literal: For civil officials, honorary salary ranks from Court Gentleman for Discussion and substantive posts from Director of the Court of Judicial Review downward, when not bestowed by edict from the Secretariat, they belonged to the Ministry Director's Left Selection;
translations.idiomatic: Civil honorary ranks from Court Gentleman for Discussion upward and substantive posts from Director of the Court of Judicial Review downward, when not granted by Secretariat edict, belonged to the Ministry Director's Left Selection;

sentences.zh: 武臣升朝官自皇城使、職事官自金吾階衛仗司以下，非樞密院宣授者，歸尚書右選；

translations.literal: for military officials in court audience from Imperial City Commissioner and substantive posts from the Jinwu Guard and Palace Arms Service downward, when not proclaimed and appointed by the Bureau of Military Affairs, they belonged to the Ministry Director's Right Selection;
translations.idiomatic: military officials in court audience from Imperial City Commissioner upward and substantive posts from the Jinwu Guard and Palace Arms Service downward, when not proclaimed and appointed by the Bureau of Military Affairs, belonged to the Ministry Director's Right Selection;

sentences.zh: 自初仕至州縣幕職官，歸侍郎左選；

translations.literal: from first appointment through prefectural and county staff posts, they belonged to the Vice Director's Left Selection;
translations.idiomatic: from first appointment through prefectural and county staff posts, they belonged to the Vice Director's Left Selection;

sentences.zh: 自借差、監當至供奉官、軍使，歸侍郎右選。

translations.literal: from temporary assignment and supervisory duty through palace attendant and army commissioner, they belonged to the Vice Director's Right Selection.
translations.idiomatic: from temporary assignment and supervisory duty through palace attendant and army commissioner, they belonged to the Vice Director's Right Selection.

sentences.zh: 凡應注擬、升移、敘復、蔭補、封贈、酬賞，隨所分隸校勘合格，團甲以上尚書省，若中散大夫、閣門使以上，則列選敘之狀上中書省、樞密院，得畫旨，給告身。

translations.literal: For all who should receive assignment, promotion and transfer, reinstatement, yin supplementation, enfeoffment and posthumous grant, and reward, according to their subordinate jurisdiction they were collated for qualification, grouped in registers and sent up to the Ministry; if Grand Master of Palace Attendance or Gate Commissioner and above, then the selection and seniority memorial was listed and sent up to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs; upon receiving marked approval, appointment credentials were issued.
translations.idiomatic: All matters of assignment, promotion, reinstatement, yin supplementation, enfeoffment and posthumous honors, and reward required verification under the appropriate jurisdiction; registers were then submitted to the Ministry, while from Grand Master of Palace Attendance and Gate Commissioner upward a selection-and-seniority memorial went to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs; only after marked imperial approval were appointment credentials issued.

sentences.zh: 凡選人階官為七等：其一曰三京府判官，留守判官，節度、觀察判官；

translations.literal: For all candidates, ranked posts were of seven grades: the first were the judicial administrators of the three capital prefectures, the judicial administrators of military commissioners in residence, and the judicial administrators of military and surveillance commissioners;
translations.idiomatic: Candidates' ranked posts fell into seven grades. The first comprised judicial administrators of the three capital prefectures, judicial administrators of commissioners in residence, and judicial administrators of military and surveillance commissioners;

sentences.zh: （即後來承直郎。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, later the rank of Chengzhilang.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, later the rank of Chengzhilang, Court Gentleman for Direct Achievement.)

sentences.zh: 其二曰節度掌書記，觀察支使，防禦、團練判官；

translations.literal: the second were military commissioners' secretaries, surveillance commissioners' staff envoys, and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners;
translations.idiomatic: the second comprised military commissioners' secretaries, surveillance commissioners' staff envoys, and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners;

sentences.zh: （即後來儒林郎。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, later the rank of Rulinlang.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, later the rank of Rulinlang, Gentleman of the Forest of Scholars.)

sentences.zh: 其三曰軍事判官，京府、留守、節度、觀察推官；

translations.literal: the third were military judicial administrators and investigating officials of the capital prefecture, commissioners in residence, military commissioners, and surveillance commissioners;
translations.idiomatic: the third comprised military judicial administrators and investigating officials of the capital prefecture, commissioners in residence, military commissioners, and surveillance commissioners;

sentences.zh: （即後來文林郎。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, later the rank of Wenlinlang.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, later the rank of Wenlinlang, Gentleman of the Forest of Letters.)

sentences.zh: 其四曰防禦、團練、軍事推官，軍、監判官；

translations.literal: the fourth were investigating officials of defense, training, and military commissioners and judicial administrators of army and supervisory posts;
translations.idiomatic: the fourth comprised investigating officials of defense, training, and military commissioners and judicial administrators of army and supervisory posts;

sentences.zh: （即後來從事郎。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, later the rank of Congshilang.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, later the rank of Congshilang, Gentleman for Attendant Service.)

sentences.zh: 其五曰縣令、錄事參軍；

translations.literal: the fifth were county magistrates and recording secretaries;
translations.idiomatic: the fifth comprised county magistrates and recording secretaries;

sentences.zh: （即後來從政郎。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, later the rank of Congzhenglang.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, later the rank of Congzhenglang, Gentleman for Participation in Governance.)

sentences.zh: 其六曰試銜縣令、知錄事；

translations.literal: the sixth were county magistrates with provisional titles and acting recording secretaries;
translations.idiomatic: the sixth comprised county magistrates holding provisional titles and acting recording secretaries;

sentences.zh: （即後來修職郎。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, later the rank of Xiuzhilang.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, later the rank of Xiuzhilang, Gentleman for Cultivation of Office.)

sentences.zh: 其七曰三京軍巡判官，司理、戶曹、司戶、法曹、司法參軍，主簿，縣尉。

translations.literal: the seventh were military patrol judicial administrators of the three capitals, judicial, household, registry, law, and judicial-review secretaries, chief clerks, and county vice magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: the seventh comprised military patrol judicial administrators of the three capitals, judicial, household, registry, law, and judicial-review secretaries, chief clerks, and county vice magistrates.

sentences.zh: （即後來迪功郎。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, later the rank of Digonglang.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, later the rank of Digonglang, Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.)

sentences.zh: 七階選人須三任六考，用奏薦及功賞，乃得升改。

translations.literal: Candidates of the seven grades had to serve three terms with six appraisals and, by memorial recommendation and merit reward, only then could they be promoted and changed.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates in the seven grades had to complete three terms and six performance reviews and secure memorial recommendations and merit rewards before they could be promoted.

sentences.zh: 凡改官，留守、兩府、兩使判官，進士授太常丞，

translations.literal: For all office changes: for judicial administrators of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, and the two commissioners, presented scholars received Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices,
translations.idiomatic: On promotion to higher office: presented scholars who had served as judicial administrators of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, or the two commissioners received appointment as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices,

sentences.zh: （舊亦授正言、監察或太常博士，後多不除。）〉

translations.literal: (Formerly they were also appointed Rectifier or Investigating Censor or Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, but later these were mostly not conferred.)
translations.idiomatic: (Formerly they might also receive Rectifier, Investigating Censor, or Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, but later these posts were seldom filled.)

sentences.zh: 餘人太子中允；

translations.literal: others received Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household;
translations.idiomatic: while others received Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household;

sentences.zh: （舊亦授殿中丞。）〉

translations.literal: (Formerly they were also appointed Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service.)
translations.idiomatic: (Formerly they might also receive Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service.)

sentences.zh: 支使，掌書記，防禦、團練判官，進士授太子中允，

translations.literal: staff envoys, secretaries, and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners: presented scholars received Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household,
translations.idiomatic: staff envoys, secretaries, and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners: presented scholars received Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household,

sentences.zh: （或秘書郎。）〉

translations.literal: (or Secretary of the Palace Library.)
translations.idiomatic: (or Secretary of the Palace Library.)

sentences.zh: 餘人著作佐郎；

translations.literal: others received Assistant Editor in the Palace Library;
translations.idiomatic: while others received Assistant Editor in the Palace Library;

sentences.zh: 兩使推官、軍事判官、令、錄事參軍，進士授著作佐郎，餘人大理寺丞；

translations.literal: investigating officials of the two commissioners, military judicial administrators, magistrates, and recording secretaries: presented scholars received Assistant Editor in the Palace Library, others received Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review;
translations.idiomatic: investigating officials of the two commissioners, military judicial administrators, magistrates, and recording secretaries: presented scholars received Assistant Editor in the Palace Library, others Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review;

sentences.zh: 初等職官知縣，知錄事參軍，防禦、團練、軍事推官，軍、監判官，進士授大理寺丞，餘人衛尉寺丞；

translations.literal: entry-level officials serving as county magistrates, acting recording secretaries, investigating officials of defense, training, and military commissioners, and judicial administrators of army and supervisory posts: presented scholars received Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, others received Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud;
translations.idiomatic: entry-level officials serving as county magistrates, acting recording secretaries, investigating officials of defense, training, and military commissioners, and judicial administrators of army and supervisory posts: presented scholars received Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, others Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud;

sentences.zh: 惟判、司、主簿、縣尉七考，進士授大理寺丞，餘人衛尉寺丞。

translations.literal: only for judicial administrators, secretaries, chief clerks, and county vice magistrates with seven appraisals: presented scholars received Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, others received Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: only judicial administrators, secretaries, chief clerks, and county vice magistrates with seven appraisals: presented scholars received Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, others Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 自節、察判官至簿、尉，考不及格者遞降等。

translations.literal: From military and surveillance judicial administrators down to clerks and vice magistrates, those who failed appraisal were demoted grade by grade.
translations.idiomatic: From military and surveillance judicial administrators down to clerks and vice magistrates, those who failed their appraisals were demoted one grade at a time.

sentences.zh: 凡非登科及特旨者，年二十五方注官。

translations.literal: For all who had not passed the examinations or received special edicts, only at age twenty-five were they assigned office.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had not passed the examinations or received a special edict could not be assigned office until they were twenty-five.

sentences.zh: 凡三班院，二十以上聽差使，初任皆監當，次任為監押、巡檢、知縣。

translations.literal: For the Third-Class Hall, those twenty and above were permitted dispatch on assignment; first appointments were all supervisory duty, second appointments were supervisory custody, patrol inspection, or county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: In the Third-Class Hall, men twenty and older could be sent on assignment; first appointments were always supervisory duty, second appointments supervisory custody, patrol inspection, or county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 凡流外人，三任七考，有舉者六員，移縣今、通判；

translations.literal: For all outside-the-stream personnel, after three terms and seven appraisals, with six recommenders they were transferred to county magistrate or transit intendant;
translations.idiomatic: Outside-the-stream personnel, after three terms and seven appraisals with six recommenders, could be transferred to county magistrate or transit intendant;

sentences.zh: 有班行舉者三員，與磨勘。

translations.literal: with three recommenders from the roster ranks, they received merit review.
translations.idiomatic: with three recommenders from the roster ranks, they received merit review.

sentences.zh: 凡進納人，六考，有職官或縣令舉者四員，移注；

translations.literal: For all who entered by purchase, after six appraisals, with four recommenders who were substantive officials or county magistrates, they received transfer assignment;
translations.idiomatic: Those who entered by purchase, after six appraisals with four recommenders who were substantive officials or county magistrates, received transfer assignment;

sentences.zh: 四任十考，有改官者五人舉之，與磨勘。

translations.literal: after four terms and ten appraisals, with five recommenders who had changed office, they received merit review.
translations.idiomatic: after four terms and ten appraisals, with five recommenders who had themselves been promoted, they received merit review.

sentences.zh: 初定四時參選之製：凡本屬發選解，並以四孟月十五日前達省，自千里至五千里外，為五等日期離本處；

translations.literal: At first the four-season candidacy system was fixed: for all selection memorials issued by the home jurisdiction, they had to reach the province by the fifteenth day of the four first months; from one thousand to beyond five thousand li, five grades of dates were set for departure from one's place;
translations.idiomatic: The four-season candidacy system was first established: selection memorials from the home jurisdiction had to reach the capital by the fifteenth of each first month of the season; departures from one's post were staggered in five grades from one thousand li to beyond five thousand li;

sentences.zh: 若違限及不如式，本判官罰五十直，錄事參軍、本曹官各殿一選；

translations.literal: if the deadline was violated or the form was incorrect, the local judicial administrator was fined fifty strings, and the recording secretary and bureau officials each suffered one demotion in selection;
translations.idiomatic: if the deadline was missed or the form was incorrect, the local judicial administrator was fined fifty strings, and the recording secretary and bureau officials each suffered one demotion in the selection roster;

sentences.zh: 諸州四時具員闕報吏部，逾期及漏誤，判官罰七十直，錄事參軍以下殿一選；

translations.literal: the various prefectures in the four seasons submitted registers of vacancies to the Ministry of Personnel; if overdue or with omissions and errors, the judicial administrator was fined seventy strings, and the recording secretary and below suffered one demotion in selection;
translations.idiomatic: prefectures each season submitted vacancy registers to the Ministry of Personnel; if these were overdue or contained omissions and errors, the judicial administrator was fined seventy strings and the recording secretary and subordinates suffered one demotion in the selection roster;

sentences.zh: 在京百司發選解及送闕，違期亦有罰；

translations.literal: the various offices in the capital issuing selection memorials and transmitting vacancies also had penalties for lateness;
translations.idiomatic: capital ministries that issued selection memorials or transmitted vacancies were likewise penalized for lateness;

sentences.zh: 諸歸司官奏年滿，俟敕下，準格取本司文解赴集，流外銓則據其人自投狀申奏，亦依四時取解參選；

translations.literal: all officials returning to their bureau reported when their term was full; after awaiting the edict, according to regulations they took their bureau's release document to assemble for selection; the outside-the-stream selection commission relied on the person himself submitting a petition for memorial, also following the four seasons in taking release and participating in selection;
translations.idiomatic: officials returning to their home bureau reported when their term expired; after the edict issued, they took their bureau's release document to assemble for selection under the regulations; the outside-the-stream commission relied on the candidate's own petition and likewise followed the four-season schedule for release and candidacy;

sentences.zh: 凡州縣老疾不任事者，許判官、錄事參軍糾舉以聞，判官、錄事參軍則州長吏糾之。

translations.literal: For all prefectural and county officials who were aged, ill, or unfit for duty, judicial administrators and recording secretaries were permitted to impeach and report; judicial administrators and recording secretaries were impeached by the prefectural chief.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural and county officials who were aged, ill, or unfit for duty could be impeached and reported by judicial administrators and recording secretaries; judicial administrators and recording secretaries in turn were impeached by the prefectural chief.

sentences.zh: 藩郡監牧，每遣朝臣攝守，往往專恣。

translations.literal: In frontier prefectures and pasture commissions, court officials were often sent to serve as acting administrators, and they frequently acted arbitrarily.
translations.idiomatic: In frontier prefectures and pasture commissions, court officials were often sent as acting administrators, and they frequently acted with arbitrary authority.

sentences.zh: 太祖始削外權，命文臣往蒞之；

translations.literal: Taizu first curtailed outside power and ordered civil officials to go and preside;
translations.idiomatic: Taizu first curtailed the power of regional strongmen and ordered civil officials to take charge;

sentences.zh: 由是內外所授官，多非本職，惟以差遣為資曆。

translations.literal: from this, offices granted inside and outside were mostly not their substantive posts, and only temporary assignment served as seniority.
translations.idiomatic: thereafter appointments inside and outside the capital were often not to substantive posts, and seniority was reckoned chiefly by temporary assignment.

sentences.zh: 建隆四年，詔選朝士分治劇邑，以重其事。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jianlong, an edict ordered selection of court scholars to govern difficult counties separately, to give weight to the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jianlong, an edict ordered court officials selected to govern demanding counties in rotation, thereby elevating the importance of the post.

sentences.zh: 大理正奚嶼知館陶，監察御史王祐知魏，楊應夢知永濟，屯田員外郎於繼徽知臨清，常參官宰縣自此始。

translations.literal: Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xi Yu governed Guantao, Investigating Censor Wang You governed Wei, Yang Yingmeng governed Yongji, Vice Director of the Field Cultivation Bureau Yu Jihui governed Linqing—from this began regular-attendance officials administering counties.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Court of Judicial Review Xi Yu was assigned to Guantao, Investigating Censor Wang You to Wei, Yang Yingmeng to Yongji, and Vice Director of the Field Cultivation Bureau Yu Jihui to Linqing—thus began the practice of regular-attendance officials serving as county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 舊制，畿內縣赤，次赤，畿外三千戶以上為望，二千戶以上為緊，一千戶以上為上，五百戶以上為中，不滿五百戶為中下。

translations.literal: Under the old system, within the capital circuit counties were classified as red, next red; outside the circuit, three thousand households and above were designated eminent, two thousand and above pressing, one thousand and above upper, five hundred and above middle, and below five hundred lower-middle.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, counties within the capital circuit were classified as red or next red; outside the circuit, counties of three thousand households or more were eminent, of two thousand or more pressing, of one thousand or more upper, of five hundred or more middle, and below five hundred lower-middle.

sentences.zh: 有司請據諸道所具板圖之數，升降天下縣，以四千戶以上為望，三千戶以上為緊，二千戶以上為上，千戶以上為中，不滿千戶為中下。

translations.literal: The relevant offices requested that according to the household figures on the registers submitted by the various circuits, counties throughout the realm be raised or lowered: four thousand households and above as eminent, three thousand and above pressing, two thousand and above upper, one thousand and above middle, and below one thousand lower-middle.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices requested that, on the basis of household figures from registers submitted by the circuits, counties throughout the realm be reclassified: four thousand households or more as eminent, three thousand or more as pressing, two thousand or more as upper, one thousand or more as middle, and below one thousand as lower-middle.

sentences.zh: 自是，注擬以為資敘。

translations.literal: From this, assignment took this as the basis for seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter assignments were ordered with this classification as the basis for seniority.

sentences.zh: 又詔：“周廣順中應出選門州縣官，於南曹投狀，準格敕考校無礙，與除官；

translations.literal: Another edict stated: "In the Guangshun era of Zhou, prefectural and county officials who should leave the selection gate, at the Southern Bureau submitted petitions; according to regulations and edicts they were examined without impediment and given office;
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "In the Guangshun era of Zhou, prefectural and county officials due to leave the selection process submitted petitions at the Southern Bureau; if examination under the regulations and edicts found no impediment, office was conferred;

sentences.zh: 其敘復者，刑部檢勘送銓。

translations.literal: for those reinstated, the Ministry of Justice collated and sent them to the selection commission."
translations.idiomatic: those seeking reinstatement were collated by the Ministry of Justice and sent to the selection commission."

sentences.zh: 先是，選格未備。

translations.literal: Previously, the selection regulations were not complete.
translations.idiomatic: Previously the selection regulations were incomplete.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年，命陶穀等議：

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiande, Tao Gu and others were ordered to deliberate:
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qiande, Tao Gu and others were ordered to deliberate:

sentences.zh: 凡拔萃、製舉及進士、《九經》判中者，並入初等職官，判下者依常選。

translations.literal: For all who passed the Exceptional Promotion, Decree Examination, and Presented Scholar examinations and the Nine Classics judgment at the middle level, all entered entry-level office; those at the lower level followed regular selection.
translations.idiomatic: All who passed the Exceptional Promotion, Decree Examination, and Presented Scholar examinations and achieved a middle grade on the Nine Classics judgment entered entry-level office; those at the lower grade followed regular selection.

sentences.zh: 初入防禦團練軍事推官、軍事判官者，並授將仕郎，試校書郎。

translations.literal: Those first entering as investigating officials of defense, training, and military commissioners or as military judicial administrators all received Gentleman for Initial Service and were tried as Secretary of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: Those first appointed investigating officials of defense, training, and military commissioners or military judicial administrators all received Gentleman for Initial Service and were tried out as Secretary of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 周三年得資，即入留守兩府節度推官、軍事判官，並授承奉郎，試大理評事。

translations.literal: After a full three years gaining seniority, they entered as investigating officials of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, and military commissioners, or as military judicial administrators, all receiving Gentleman for Court Service and tried as Evaluator in the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: After a full three years' seniority they advanced to investigating officials of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, and military commissioners, or to military judicial administrators, receiving Gentleman for Court Service and a trial appointment as Evaluator in the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 又周三年得資，即入掌書記、防禦團練判官，並授宣德郎，試大理評事兼監察御史。

translations.literal: After another full three years gaining seniority, they entered as secretaries and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners, all receiving Gentleman for Promoting Virtue and tried as Evaluator in the Court of Judicial Review concurrent with Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: After another full three years' seniority they advanced to secretaries and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners, receiving Gentleman for Promoting Virtue and a trial appointment as Evaluator in the Court of Judicial Review concurrent with Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 周二年得資，即入留守、兩府、節度、觀察判官，並授朝散大夫，試大理司直兼監察御史。

translations.literal: After a full two years gaining seniority, they entered as judicial administrators of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, military commissioners, and surveillance commissioners, all receiving Grand Master for Court Assembly and tried as Directing Judge in the Court of Judicial Review concurrent with Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: After a full two years' seniority they advanced to judicial administrators of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, military commissioners, and surveillance commissioners, receiving Grand Master for Court Assembly and a trial appointment as Directing Judge in the Court of Judicial Review concurrent with Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 周一年，入同類職事、諸府少尹。

translations.literal: After one full year, they entered similar substantive posts and junior administrators of the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: After one full year they advanced to similar substantive posts and junior administrators of the various prefectures.

sentences.zh: 又周一年，送名中書門下，仍依官階，分為四等。

translations.literal: After another full year, their names were sent to the Secretariat and Chancellery, still according to official grade divided into four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: After another full year their names were sent to the Secretariat and Chancellery and, according to official grade, divided into four ranks.

sentences.zh: 已至兩使判官以上、次任入同類職事者，加檢校官或轉憲銜。

translations.literal: Those who had already reached judicial administrators of the two commissioners and above, on the next term entering similar substantive posts, received added provisional posts or transfer to censorial titles.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had already reached judicial administrators of the two commissioners and above, on entering similar substantive posts in the next term, received added provisional titles or transfer to censorial ranks.

sentences.zh: 凡觀察判官以上，緋十五年乃賜紫。

translations.literal: For all surveillance judicial administrators and above, after fifteen years in crimson they were granted purple.
translations.idiomatic: Surveillance judicial administrators and above wore crimson for fifteen years before being granted purple.

sentences.zh: 每任以周三年為限，閏月不預，每周一年，校成一考。

translations.literal: Each term was limited to a full three years; intercalary months did not count; each full year completed one appraisal.
translations.idiomatic: Each term was limited to a full three years, intercalary months excluded; each full year completed one performance review.

sentences.zh: 其常考，依令錄例，書“中”、“上”；

translations.literal: For regular appraisals, following the magistrate and recording secretary precedent, they wrote "middle" or "upper";
translations.idiomatic: Regular appraisals, following the precedent for magistrates and recording secretaries, were recorded as "middle" or "upper";

sentences.zh: 公事闕遺、曾經殿罰者，即降考一等；

translations.literal: if public business was neglected or they had once been demoted in selection, the appraisal was lowered one grade;
translations.idiomatic: if public business was neglected or they had once been demoted in the selection roster, the appraisal was lowered one grade;

sentences.zh: 若校成殊考，則南曹具功績，請行酬獎；

translations.literal: if an outstanding appraisal was completed, the Southern Bureau prepared the achievements and requested reward;
translations.idiomatic: if an outstanding appraisal was completed, the Southern Bureau prepared a record of achievements and requested reward;

sentences.zh: 或考滿末代，更一周年與成第四考，隨有罷者不赴集；

translations.literal: or if the term was full but the replacement had not arrived, after one more full year a fourth appraisal was completed; if there was dismissal they did not assemble;
translations.idiomatic: or if a term ended before a successor arrived, after one more full year a fourth appraisal was completed; those dismissed did not assemble for selection;

sentences.zh: 其奏授職事，書校考第，並準新格參選。

translations.literal: for memorial-appointed substantive posts, the appraisal grades were written, all following the new regulations for candidacy.
translations.idiomatic: for memorial-appointed substantive posts, appraisal grades were recorded, and all followed the new regulations for candidacy.

sentences.zh: 自是銓法漸有倫矣。

translations.literal: From this the appraisal law gradually had order.
translations.idiomatic: From this point the appraisal regulations gradually acquired systematic order.

sentences.zh: 帝又慮銓曹惟用資曆，而才傑或湛滯，乃詔吏部取赴集選人曆任課績多而無闕失、其材可副升擢者，送中書引驗以聞。

translations.literal: The Emperor also feared that the selection office used only seniority, while talented men might be submerged and stalled; he therefore ordered the Ministry of Personnel to take candidates assembling for selection whose records of successive terms showed many appraisals without fault and whose talent could match promotion and advancement, and send them to the Secretariat for verification and report.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor also feared that the selection office relied solely on seniority while talented men languished in obscurity; he therefore ordered the Ministry of Personnel to identify candidates assembling for selection whose successive terms showed many appraisals without fault and whose ability warranted promotion, and send them to the Secretariat for verification and report.

sentences.zh: 時仕者愈眾，頗委積不可遣。

translations.literal: At the time officeholders grew ever more numerous, and the backlog could not be dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: By then officeholders had grown so numerous that the backlog could not be cleared.

sentences.zh: 開寶初，令選人應格者，到京即赴集，不必限四時；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaibao, it was ordered that qualified candidates, upon reaching the capital, should assemble immediately, not limited to the four seasons;
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaibao, qualified candidates were ordered to assemble as soon as they reached the capital, without waiting for the four seasonal rounds;

sentences.zh: 及成甲次，又給限：南曹八日，銓司旬有五日，門下省七日，自磨勘、注擬及點檢謝詞，總毋逾一月。

translations.literal: when the register order was formed, limits were again set: the Southern Bureau eight days, the selection office fifteen days, the Chancellery seven days—from merit review, assignment, and inspection of thanks for appointment, in total not exceeding one month.
translations.idiomatic: once the register order was formed, time limits were set: eight days for the Southern Bureau, fifteen for the selection office, seven for the Chancellery—from merit review and assignment through inspection of the thanks-for-appointment address, the whole process was not to exceed one month.

sentences.zh: 若別論課績，或負過名須考驗，行遣如法；

translations.literal: if merit was separately discussed or there was a record of fault requiring verification, dispatch proceeded according to law;
translations.idiomatic: if merit was separately assessed or a record of fault required verification, dispatch proceeded according to law;

sentences.zh: 及資考未合注擬者，不在此限。

translations.literal: and those whose seniority and appraisals did not yet qualify for assignment were not within this limit.
translations.idiomatic: those whose seniority and appraisals did not yet qualify for assignment were not subject to this limit.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔曰：“吏多難以求其治，祿薄末可責其廉，與其冗員重費，不若省官益奉。

translations.literal: In the third year, an edict stated: "With many officials it is hard to seek good governance; with thin salaries one cannot demand integrity—rather than redundant staff and heavy expense, it is better to reduce officials and increase salaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, an edict stated: "When officials are too numerous, good governance is hard to achieve; when salaries are too thin, integrity cannot be demanded. Rather than maintain a redundant staff at heavy expense, it is better to reduce posts and increase salaries.

sentences.zh: 州縣官宜以戶口為率，差減其員，舊奉月增給五千。

translations.literal: Prefectural and county officials should take household population as the measure, reduce posts by graded difference, and the old monthly salary be increased by five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural and county posts should be reduced in proportion to household population, and former monthly salaries increased by five thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 西川管內諸州，凡二萬戶，依舊設曹官三員；

translations.literal: For the various prefectures within Xichuan circuit, wherever there were twenty thousand households, the former three bureau officials were to remain established;
translations.idiomatic: For prefectures within Xichuan circuit with twenty thousand households, the former complement of three bureau officials was retained;

sentences.zh: 戶不滿二萬，置錄事參軍、司法參軍各一員，司法兼司戶；

translations.literal: where households did not reach twenty thousand, one recording secretary and one judicial-review secretary were appointed, the judicial-review secretary also handling registry duties;
translations.idiomatic: where households fell short of twenty thousand, one recording secretary and one judicial-review secretary were appointed, with the judicial-review secretary also serving as registry secretary;

sentences.zh: 不滿萬戶，止置司法、司戶，司戶兼錄事參軍；

translations.literal: where households did not reach ten thousand, only judicial-review and registry secretaries were appointed, the registry secretary also serving as recording secretary;
translations.idiomatic: where households fell short of ten thousand, only judicial-review and registry secretaries were appointed, with the registry secretary also serving as recording secretary;

sentences.zh: 戶不滿五千，止置司戶，兼司法及錄事參軍。

translations.literal: where households did not reach five thousand, only a registry secretary was appointed, also serving as judicial-review and recording secretary.
translations.idiomatic: where households fell short of five thousand, only a registry secretary was appointed, who also served as judicial-review and recording secretary.

sentences.zh: 縣千戶以上，依舊置令、尉、主簿凡三員；

translations.literal: for counties of one thousand households or more, the former three posts of magistrate, vice magistrate, and chief clerk were established;
translations.idiomatic: for counties of one thousand households or more, the former three posts of magistrate, vice magistrate, and chief clerk were retained;

sentences.zh: 戶不滿千，置令、尉，縣令兼主簿事；

translations.literal: where households did not reach one thousand, a magistrate and vice magistrate were appointed, the county magistrate also handling chief clerk duties;
translations.idiomatic: where households fell short of one thousand, a magistrate and vice magistrate were appointed, with the county magistrate also handling chief clerk duties;

sentences.zh: 戶不滿四百，止置主簿、尉，以主簿兼知縣事；

translations.literal: where households did not reach four hundred, only chief clerk and vice magistrate were appointed, with the chief clerk also serving as acting county magistrate;
translations.idiomatic: where households fell short of four hundred, only a chief clerk and vice magistrate were appointed, with the chief clerk also serving as acting county magistrate;

sentences.zh: 戶不滿二百，止置主簿，兼令、尉。

translations.literal: where households did not reach two hundred, only a chief clerk was appointed, also serving as magistrate and vice magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: where households fell short of two hundred, only a chief clerk was appointed, who also served as magistrate and vice magistrate.

sentences.zh: ”諸道減員亦仿此製。

translations.literal: "Reduction of staff in the various circuits likewise followed this system.
translations.idiomatic: "Staff reductions in the other circuits likewise followed this system.

sentences.zh: 西川官考滿得代，更不守選。

translations.literal: Xichuan officials, once their term appraisals were complete and successors arrived, no longer waited for selection.
translations.idiomatic: Xichuan officials who completed their term appraisals and were replaced no longer had to wait for selection.

sentences.zh: 嶺表初平，上以其民久困苛政，思惠養之。

translations.literal: When the Lingnan region was first pacified, the Emperor, seeing that its people had long suffered under harsh government, wished to nurture them with kindness.
translations.idiomatic: When Lingnan was first pacified, the Emperor, seeing that its people had long suffered under harsh government, wished to nurture them with benevolent care.

sentences.zh: 令吏部銓自襄、荊以南州縣，選見任年未五十者，移為嶺南諸州通判，得攜族之官。

translations.literal: He ordered the Ministry of Personnel selection to take prefectural and county officials from south of Xiang and Jing, choose incumbent officials under fifty years of age, transfer them to transit intendant posts in the various Lingnan prefectures, and allow them to bring their families to office.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Ministry of Personnel to select prefectural and county officials from south of Xiang and Jing, choose incumbents under fifty years of age, transfer them to transit intendant posts in the Lingnan prefectures, and permit them to bring their families to office.

sentences.zh: 以廣南偽署官送學士院試書判，稍優則授上佐、令、錄、簿、尉。

translations.literal: Formerly appointed officials from southern Guang were sent to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies for document-judgment examination; those slightly superior were granted chief administrators, magistrates, recording secretaries, chief clerks, or vice magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Former officials of the southern Guang regime were sent to the Academy of Scholarly Worthies for document-judgment examination; those who performed somewhat better were appointed chief administrators, magistrates, recording secretaries, chief clerks, or vice magistrates.

sentences.zh: 初，州縣有闕員，差前資官承攝；

translations.literal: Initially, when prefectures and counties had vacancies, senior-service officials were dispatched to fill them provisionally;
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when prefectures and counties had vacancies, officials with prior service records were dispatched to fill them provisionally;

sentences.zh: 帝以其紊常製，令所在即上闕員，有司除注。

translations.literal: The Emperor, seeing that this disrupted the regular system, ordered locales to report vacancies immediately so that the responsible offices could appoint and assign.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, seeing that this disrupted the regular system, ordered each locality to report vacancies at once so that the responsible offices could appoint replacements.

sentences.zh: 又謂：“諸道攝官或著吏能，悉令罷去，良可惜也。

translations.literal: He also said: "Provisional officials in the various circuits who have shown administrative ability—all are ordered dismissed; that is truly a pity.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Provisional officials in the various circuits who have shown real administrative ability are all being dismissed—that is truly a waste.

sentences.zh: 有司按其曆任，三攝無曠敗者以名聞。

translations.literal: Let the responsible offices review their successive service records; those who served three provisional terms without absence or failure are to be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Let the responsible offices review their successive service records and report by name those who served three provisional terms without absence or failure.

sentences.zh: 六年，從流內銓之請，復四時選，而引對者每季一時引對之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, following the request of the Within-the-Stream Selection, the four-season selection was restored, and those receiving audience were granted audience once each season.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, at the request of the Within-the-Stream Selection, the four-season selection was restored, and those called for audience received audience once each season.

sentences.zh: 時國家取荊、衡，克梁、益，下交、廣，辟土既遠，吏多闕，是以歲常放選。

translations.literal: At the time the state had taken Jing and Heng, conquered Liang and Yi, and subdued Jiao and Guang; with territory extending far, many official posts were vacant, and so selection was regularly opened each year.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the state had taken Jing and Heng, conquered Liang and Yi, and subdued Jiao and Guang; with territory extending far, many posts stood vacant, and so selection was regularly opened each year.

sentences.zh: 選人南曹投狀，判成送銓，依次注擬。

translations.literal: Candidates submitted petitions to the Southern Bureau; once judgments were completed they were sent to the selection commission, which assigned posts in order.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates submitted petitions to the Southern Bureau; once judgments were completed, they were sent to the selection commission, which drew up assignments in order.

sentences.zh: 其後選部闕官，即特詔免解，非時赴集，謂之“放選”，習以為常，而取解季集之製漸廢。

translations.literal: Thereafter, when the Selection Department had vacant posts, special edicts exempted candidates from waiting and allowed out-of-season assembly—these were called "open selection" and became customary, while the system of obtaining qualification and seasonal assembly gradually fell into disuse.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, when the Selection Department had vacant posts, special edicts exempted candidates from waiting and allowed out-of-season assembly—called "open selection"—which became customary, while the system of obtaining qualification and seasonal assembly gradually fell into disuse.

sentences.zh: 是冬，乃命參知政事盧多遜等，以見行《長定》、《循資格》及泛降制書，乃正違異，削去重復，補其闕漏，參校詳議，取悠久可用者，為書上之，頒為永式，而銓綜之職益有敘矣。

translations.literal: That winter, Vice Grand Councilor Lu Duosun and others were ordered, using the current Long-Term Regulations, Seniority Regulations, and broadly issued edicts, to rectify discrepancies, eliminate duplications, supplement omissions, compare and deliberate in detail, select what could serve permanently, compile a book and submit it, promulgate it as permanent regulations—and the duties of comprehensive appraisal gained greater order.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, Vice Grand Councilor Lu Duosun and others were ordered to use the current Long-Term Regulations, Seniority Regulations, and broadly issued edicts to rectify discrepancies, eliminate duplication, fill gaps, compare and deliberate in detail, select provisions of lasting use, compile them into a book and submit it, and promulgate it as permanent regulations—whereupon the duties of comprehensive appraisal gained greater order.

sentences.zh: 先是，選人試判三道，其二全通而文翰俱優為上，一道全通而文翰稍堪為中，三道俱不通為下。

translations.literal: Previously, candidates were tested with three document judgments: if two were wholly passed with both literary composition excellent, that was upper grade; if one was wholly passed with literary composition slightly adequate, middle grade; if all three failed, lower grade.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, candidates were tested with three document judgments: if two were wholly passed with both literary composition excellent, that counted as upper grade; if one was wholly passed with literary composition slightly adequate, middle grade; if all three failed, lower grade.

sentences.zh: 判上者職事官加一階，州縣官超一資，判中依資，判下入同類，惟黃衣人降一資。

translations.literal: Upper judgment: substantive officials advanced one rank; prefectural and county officials skipped one seniority grade; middle judgment followed seniority; lower judgment entered with peers; only yellow-robed candidates were reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: Upper judgment: substantive officials advanced one rank; prefectural and county officials skipped one seniority grade; middle judgment followed seniority; lower judgment entered with peers; only yellow-robed candidates were reduced one grade.

sentences.zh: 至是，增為四等，三道全次、文翰無取者為中下，用舊判下格；

translations.literal: At this point it was increased to four grades: all three wholly passed with literary composition unremarkable was lower-middle, using the old lower-judgment rule;
translations.idiomatic: At this point the grades were increased to four: all three wholly passed but with unremarkable literary composition counted as lower-middle, using the old lower-judgment rule;

sentences.zh: 全不通而文翰又紕繆為下，殿一選。

translations.literal: complete failure with literary composition also flawed was lower grade, one demotion in selection.
translations.idiomatic: complete failure with flawed literary composition counted as lower grade, with one demotion in the selection roster.

sentences.zh: 太平興國六年，詔京朝官除兩省、御史台，自少卿、監以下，奉使從政於外受代而歸者，令中書舍人郭贄、膳部郎中兼侍御史知雜事滕中正、戶部郎中雷德驤同考校勞績，論量器材，以中書所下闕員擬定，引對以遣，謂之差遣院。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo, an edict stated that capital officials, except those in the two Secretariats and the Censorate, from Vice Director and Commissioner downward who had served missions or held outside posts and returned after replacement, were to have their service merit jointly appraised by Secretariat Drafter Guo Zan, Bureau of Rites Director and Concurrent Supervisory Censor with Mixed Affairs Teng Zhongzheng, and Bureau of Revenue Director Lei Dexiang, their talents weighed, vacancies issued by the Secretariat used to draw up assignments, and after audience they were dispatched—this was called the Assignment Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo, an edict ordered that capital officials—except those in the two Secretariats and the Censorate—from Vice Director and Commissioner downward who had served missions or held outside posts and returned after replacement were to have their service merit jointly appraised by Secretariat Drafter Guo Zan, Bureau of Rites Director and Concurrent Supervisory Censor with Mixed Affairs Teng Zhongzheng, and Bureau of Revenue Director Lei Dexiang; their talents were to be weighed, vacancies issued by the Secretariat used to draw up assignments, and after audience they were dispatched—this was called the Assignment Hall.

sentences.zh: 蓋前代朝官，自一品以下皆曰常參官，其未常參者曰未常參官；

translations.literal: Former dynasties called court officials from first rank downward regular-attendance officials; those not in regular attendance were non-regular-attendance officials;
translations.idiomatic: In former dynasties, court officials from first rank downward were called regular-attendance officials; those not in regular attendance were called non-regular-attendance officials;

sentences.zh: 宋目常參者曰朝官，秘書郎而下未常參者曰京官。

translations.literal: Under the Song designation, those in regular attendance were called court officials; those below Secretariat Director who did not regularly attend were called capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song designation, those in regular attendance were called court officials; those from Secretariat Director downward who did not regularly attend were called capital officials.

sentences.zh: 舊制，京朝官有員數，除授皆云替某官，或云填見闕。

translations.literal: Under the old system, capital officials had fixed quotas; appointments all said "replacing so-and-so's post" or "filling a current vacancy."
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, capital officials had fixed quotas; appointments were phrased as "replacing so-and-so's post" or "filling a current vacancy."

sentences.zh: 京官皆屬吏部，每任滿三十月，罷任，則歲校其考第，取解赴集。

translations.literal: Capital officials all belonged to the Ministry of Personnel; every thirty months per term, upon leaving office they had annual appraisal grades reviewed, obtained qualification, and assembled.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials all belonged to the Ministry of Personnel; after each thirty-month term, upon leaving office they had annual appraisal grades reviewed, obtained qualification, and assembled for selection.

sentences.zh: 太祖以來，凡權知諸州，若通判，若監臨物務官，無定員。

translations.literal: Since Taizu, all who temporarily served as prefectural administrators, transit intendants, or supervisors of material affairs had no fixed quotas.
translations.idiomatic: Since Taizu, all who temporarily served as prefectural administrators, transit intendants, or supervisors of material affairs had no fixed quotas.

sentences.zh: 月限既滿，有司住給奉料，而見厘務者牒有司復文，所厘務罷則已。

translations.literal: When the monthly term was full, the responsible office stopped salary payment; those still conducting affairs sent documents to the office for reinstatement, ending when the affair ended.
translations.idiomatic: When the monthly term expired, the responsible office stopped salary payment; those still conducting affairs sent documents to the office for reinstatement, which ceased when the affair ended.

sentences.zh: 但不常參，注授皆出中書，不復由吏部。

translations.literal: But because they did not regularly attend court, appointments and assignments all came from the Secretariat, no longer through the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: But because they did not regularly attend court, appointments and assignments all came from the Secretariat and no longer passed through the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 至是，與朝官悉差遣院主之。

translations.literal: At this point, they and court officials were all handled by the Assignment Hall.
translations.idiomatic: At this point, they and court officials were all handled by the Assignment Hall.

sentences.zh: 凡吏部黃衣選人，始許改為白衣選人。

translations.literal: All yellow-robed Ministry of Personnel candidates were first permitted to become white-robed candidates.
translations.idiomatic: All yellow-robed Ministry of Personnel candidates were first permitted to become white-robed candidates.

sentences.zh: 太宗選用庶僚，皆得引對，觀其敷納可采者超擢之。

translations.literal: Taizong in selecting subordinate officials always granted audience, observing those whose responses were worth taking and promoting them exceptionally.
translations.idiomatic: In selecting subordinate officials, Taizong always granted them audience and exceptionally promoted those whose responses were worth taking.

sentences.zh: 復慮因緣矯飾，徼幸冒進，乃詔：“ 應臨軒所選官吏，並送中書門下，考其履曆，審取進止。

translations.literal: He again feared that connections and artifice might enable lucky advancement, and therefore decreed: "All officials selected at the imperial audience are to be sent to the Secretariat-Chancellery to have their service records examined and advancement or rejection determined.
translations.idiomatic: He again feared that connections and artifice might enable lucky advancement, and therefore decreed: "All officials selected at the imperial audience are to be sent to the Secretariat-Chancellery to have their service records examined and advancement or rejection determined.

sentences.zh: ”舊制，州縣官南曹判成，流內銓注擬，其職事官中書除授。

translations.literal: " Under the old system, prefectural and county officials had judgments completed by the Southern Bureau and assignments drawn up by the Within-the-Stream Selection; substantive officials were appointed by the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: " Under the old system, prefectural and county officials had judgments completed by the Southern Bureau and assignments drawn up by the Within-the-Stream Selection; substantive officials were appointed by the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 然而曆任功過，須經南曹考驗，遂令幕府官罷任，並歸銓曹，其特除拜者聽朝旨。

translations.literal: However, merits and faults in successive terms had to pass Southern Bureau verification; therefore officials leaving secretariat posts were all sent to the selection bureau, while those specially appointed followed court edict.
translations.idiomatic: However, merits and faults in successive terms had to pass Southern Bureau verification; therefore officials leaving secretariat posts were all sent to the selection bureau, while those specially appointed followed court edict.

sentences.zh: 又詔：“獄官關係尤重，新及第人為司理參軍，固未精習，令長吏察視，不勝任者，奏，判、司、簿、尉對易其官。

translations.literal: Another edict: "Prison officials are especially important; newly passed examination graduates serving as judicial secretaries are naturally not fully practiced—let superior officials inspect them; those not competent are to be memorialized, and judicial administrators, secretaries, chief clerks, and vice magistrates are to exchange posts.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Prison officials are especially important; newly passed examination graduates serving as judicial secretaries are naturally not fully practiced—let superior officials inspect them; those found incompetent are to be memorialized, and judicial administrators, secretaries, chief clerks, and vice magistrates are to exchange posts.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，選人以南郊赦免選，悉集京師。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, candidates were exempted from selection waiting by the Southern Suburbs amnesty and all assembled at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Chunhua, candidates were exempted from selection waiting by the Southern Suburbs amnesty and all assembled at the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：“並放選，則負罪者幸矣，無罪者何以勸？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "If all are granted open selection, the guilty are fortunate—how are the innocent to be encouraged?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "If all are granted open selection, the guilty are fortunate—how are the innocent to be encouraged?

sentences.zh: ”乃令經停殿者守常選。

translations.literal: " He therefore ordered those who had suffered demotion in selection to observe regular waiting for selection.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore ordered those who had suffered demotion in selection to observe regular waiting for selection.

sentences.zh: 又詔：“司理、司法參軍在任有犯，遇赦及書下考者，止與免選，更勿超資。

translations.literal: Another edict: "Judicial and judicial-review secretaries who commit offenses while in office, if they encounter amnesty or receive written poor appraisals, are granted only exemption from selection and no longer exceptional advancement in seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "Judicial and judicial-review secretaries who commit offenses while in office, if they encounter amnesty or receive written poor appraisals, are granted only exemption from selection and no longer exceptional advancement in seniority.

sentences.zh: ”工部郎中張知白上言：“唐李嶠嚐云：‘安人之方，須擇郡守。

translations.literal: " Bureau of Works Director Zhang Zhibai memorialized: "Tang minister Li Jiao once said: 'The method of bringing peace to the people lies in selecting prefectural administrators.
translations.idiomatic: " Bureau of Works Director Zhang Zhibai memorialized: "Tang minister Li Jiao once said: 'The method of bringing peace to the people lies in selecting prefectural administrators.

sentences.zh: 朝廷重內官，輕外任，望於台閣選賢良分典大州，共康庶績。

translations.literal: The court esteems inner-circuit officials and undervalues outside appointments; I hope worthy men will be chosen from the halls and pavilions to share in governing great prefectures and together bring prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: The court esteems inner-circuit officials and undervalues outside appointments; I hope worthy men will be chosen from the halls and pavilions to share in governing great prefectures and together bring prosperity.

sentences.zh: ’鳳閣待郎韋嗣立因而請行，遂以本官出領郡。

translations.literal: ' Vice Director of the Phoenix Pavilion Wei Sili then requested to act on this and went out to head a prefecture in his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: ' Vice Director of the Phoenix Pavilion Wei Sili then requested to act on this and went out to head a prefecture in his original rank.

sentences.zh: 今江、浙州郡，方切擇人，臣雖不肖，願繼前脩。

translations.literal: Now the Jiang and Zhe prefectures and commanderies urgently need men of quality; though I am unworthy, I wish to follow this former example.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Jiang and Zhe prefectures and commanderies urgently need men of quality; though I am unworthy, I wish to follow this former example.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“知白請重親民之官，良可嘉也。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Zhibai's request to give weight to posts close to the people is truly commendable.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "Zhibai's request to give weight to posts close to the people is truly commendable.

sentences.zh: ”然不允其請。

translations.literal: " Yet his request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Yet his request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 淳化以前，資敘未一，及是始定遷秩之製：凡製舉、進士、《九經》出身者，校書郎、正字、寺監主簿、助教並轉大理評事，評事轉本寺丞，任太祝、奉禮郎者轉諸寺監丞，諸寺監丞轉著作佐郎，或特遷太子中允、秘書郎；

translations.literal: Before Chunhua, seniority was not uniform; at this point the system for rank advancement was first fixed: For Decree Examination, Presented Scholar, and 《Nine Classics》 graduates, proofreader, collator, directorate and commission chief clerks, and assistant instructors all transferred to Grand Court Assessor; assessor transferred to vice director of the same directorate; those serving as court invocator or ceremony attendant transferred to vice directors of various directorates and commissions; those vice directors transferred to Assistant Editor in the Palace Library, or were exceptionally promoted to Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household or Secretary of the Palace Library;
translations.idiomatic: Before Chunhua, seniority was not uniform; at this point the system for rank advancement was first fixed: Decree Examination, Presented Scholar, and 《Nine Classics》 graduates moved from proofreader, collator, directorate and commission chief clerk, and assistant instructor to Grand Court Assessor; assessor to vice director of the same directorate; court invocator or ceremony attendant to vice director of various directorates and commissions; those vice directors to Assistant Editor in the Palace Library, or were exceptionally promoted to Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household or Secretary of the Palace Library;

sentences.zh: 由大理寺丞轉殿中丞，由著作佐郎轉秘書監丞，資淺者或著作郎，優遷者為太常丞；

translations.literal: from Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review to Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service; from Assistant Editor to Vice Director of the Palace Library Directorate; those of shallow seniority might become Editor in the Palace Library, those exceptionally advanced became Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;
translations.idiomatic: from Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review to Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service; from Assistant Editor to Vice Director of the Palace Library Directorate; those of shallow seniority might become Editor in the Palace Library, while those exceptionally advanced became Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;

sentences.zh: 由太子中允、秘書郎轉太常丞，三丞、著作皆遷太常博士，轉屯田員外郎，優者為禮部、工部、祠部、主客；

translations.literal: from Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household or Secretary of the Palace Library to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; the three vice directors and editors all advanced to Court Scholar of Imperial Sacrifices, then to Vice Director of the Bureau of State Farms; the superior to the Ministries of Rites, Works, Ancestral Temples, or Foreign Guests;
translations.idiomatic: from Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household or Secretary of the Palace Library to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; the three vice directors and editors all advanced to Court Scholar of Imperial Sacrifices, then to Vice Director of the Bureau of State Farms; the superior to the Ministries of Rites, Works, Ancestral Temples, or Foreign Guests;

sentences.zh: 由屯田轉都官，優者為戶部、刑部、度支、金部；

translations.literal: from State Farms to Capital Crimes; the superior to the Ministries of Revenue, Punishments, Budget, or Treasury;
translations.idiomatic: from State Farms to Capital Crimes; the superior to the Ministries of Revenue, Punishments, Budget, or Treasury;

sentences.zh: 由都官轉職方，優者為吏部、兵部、司封、司勳；

translations.literal: from Capital Crimes to Bureau of Offices; the superior to the Ministries of Personnel, War, Seals, or Merits;
translations.idiomatic: from Capital Crimes to Bureau of Offices; the superior to the Ministries of Personnel, War, Seals, or Merits;

sentences.zh: 其轉郎中亦如之。

translations.literal: Promotion to director followed the same pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion to director followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 左右司員外郎，太平興國中有之，後罕除者。

translations.literal: Left and Right Department Vice Directors existed in the Taiping Xingguo era; later they were rarely appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Department Vice Directors existed in the Taiping Xingguo era; later they were rarely appointed.

sentences.zh: 左右司郎中，惟待制以上當為少卿者即為之。

translations.literal: Left and Right Department Directors were held only by draft attendant-compilers and above who were due to become vice directors.
translations.idiomatic: Left and Right Department Directors were held only by draft attendant-compilers and above who were due to become vice directors.

sentences.zh: 由前行郎中轉太常少卿、秘書少監，由此二官轉右諫議大夫或秘書監、光祿卿；

translations.literal: from front-rank directors to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices or Vice Director of the Palace Library Directorate; from these two posts to Right Remonstrance and Reviser or Director of the Palace Library or Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments;
translations.idiomatic: from front-rank directors to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices or Vice Director of the Palace Library Directorate; from these two posts to Right Remonstrance and Reviser, Director of the Palace Library, or Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments;

sentences.zh: 諫議轉給事中，資淺者或右轉左；

translations.literal: Remonstrance and Reviser transferred to Drafting Attendant; those of shallow seniority might move from right to left;
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance and Reviser transferred to Drafting Attendant; those of shallow seniority might move from right to left;

sentences.zh: 給事中轉工部、禮部侍郎，至兵部、吏部轉左右丞，由左右丞轉尚書。

translations.literal: Drafting Attendant transferred to Vice Minister of Works or Rites; reaching Ministries of War or Personnel transferred to Left or Right Vice Director; from Left or Right Vice Director to Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Drafting Attendant transferred to Vice Minister of Works or Rites; reaching the Ministries of War or Personnel, one transferred to Left or Right Vice Director; from Left or Right Vice Director to Minister.

sentences.zh: 自侍郎以上，或曆曹，或超曹，皆係特旨。

translations.literal: From Vice Minister upward, whether passing through bureaus or skipping bureaus, all depended on special edict.
translations.idiomatic: From Vice Minister upward, whether passing through bureaus or skipping bureaus, all depended on special edict.

sentences.zh: 諸科及無出身者，校書郎、正字、寺監主簿、助教並轉太祝、奉禮郎，太祝、奉禮郎轉大理評事，評事轉諸寺監丞，諸寺監丞轉大理寺丞，大理寺丞轉中舍，優者為左右讚善，資淺者為洗馬。

translations.literal: Miscellaneous examination and non-graduate candidates: proofreader, collator, directorate and commission chief clerks, and assistant instructors all transferred to court invocator or ceremony attendant; court invocator or ceremony attendant to Grand Court Assessor; assessor to vice directors of various directorates and commissions; those vice directors to Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review to Central Secretariat Drafter; the superior to Left or Right Tutor; those of shallow seniority to Groom-in-Waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous examination and non-graduate candidates moved from proofreader, collator, directorate and commission chief clerk, and assistant instructor to court invocator or ceremony attendant; court invocator or ceremony attendant to Grand Court Assessor; assessor to vice director of various directorates and commissions; those vice directors to Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review to Central Secretariat Drafter; the superior to Left or Right Tutor; those of shallow seniority to Groom-in-Waiting.

sentences.zh: 由幕職為著作佐郎者轉太子中允。

translations.literal: Those who entered as secretariat staff and became Assistant Editor transferred to Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household.
translations.idiomatic: Those who entered as secretariat staff and became Assistant Editor transferred to Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household.

sentences.zh: 由中允、讚善、中舍、洗馬皆轉殿中丞，殿中丞轉國子博士，

translations.literal: from Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household, Tutor, Central Secretariat Drafter, or Groom-in-Waiting all transferred to Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service; Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service transferred to Court Scholar of the National University,
translations.idiomatic: from Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household, Tutor, Central Secretariat Drafter, or Groom-in-Waiting all transferred to Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service; Vice Director of the Palace Domestic Service transferred to Court Scholar of the National University,

sentences.zh: （舊除《五經》者，至《春秋》博士則轉國子博士，後罕除。）〉

translations.literal: (Formerly those appointed through the 《Five Classics》, upon reaching Court Scholar of the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 transferred to Court Scholar of the National University; later such appointments were rare.)
translations.idiomatic: (Formerly those appointed through the 《Five Classics》, upon reaching Court Scholar of the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 transferred to Court Scholar of the National University; later such appointments were rare.)

sentences.zh: 由國子博士轉虞部員外郎，優者為膳部；

translations.literal: from Court Scholar of the National University to Vice Director of the Bureau of Parks and Forests; the superior to the Bureau of Provisions;
translations.idiomatic: from Court Scholar of the National University to Vice Director of the Bureau of Parks and Forests; the superior to the Bureau of Provisions;

sentences.zh: 由虞部轉比部，優者為倉部；

translations.literal: from Parks and Forests to Comparison; the superior to Granaries;
translations.idiomatic: from Parks and Forests to Comparison; the superior to Granaries;

sentences.zh: 由比部轉駕部，優者為考功；

translations.literal: from Comparison to Transport; the superior to Merits;
translations.idiomatic: from Comparison to Transport; the superior to Merits;

sentences.zh: 或由水部轉司門，司門轉庫部；

translations.literal: or from Waterways to Gatekeeping; Gatekeeping to Storehouses;
translations.idiomatic: or from Waterways to Gatekeeping; Gatekeeping to Storehouses;

sentences.zh: 為郎中亦如之。

translations.literal: Promotion to director followed the same pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Promotion to director followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 至前行郎中轉少卿、監，或一轉，或二三轉，即為諸寺大卿、監，自大卿、監特恩獎擢，或入給諫焉。

translations.literal: Upon reaching front-rank director, one transferred to vice director or commissioner; after one transfer, or two or three transfers, one became grand director or commissioner of the various directorates; from grand director or commissioner, by special grace one might be rewarded and promoted, or enter drafting and remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching front-rank director, one transferred to vice director or commissioner; after one, two, or three transfers, one became grand director or commissioner of the various directorates; from grand director or commissioner, by special grace one might be rewarded and promoted, or enter drafting and remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 其為台省官，則正言、監察比太常博士，殿中、司諫比後行員外郎，起居、侍御史比中行員外郎；

translations.literal: For Censorate and Secretariat officials: Rectifier and Investigating Censor were comparable to Court Scholar of Imperial Sacrifices; Palace and Remonstrance and Reviser were comparable to rear-rank vice director; Diarist and Attending Censor were comparable to middle-rank vice director;
translations.idiomatic: For Censorate and Secretariat officials: Rectifier and Investigating Censor were comparable to Court Scholar of Imperial Sacrifices; Palace and Remonstrance and Reviser were comparable to rear-rank vice director; Diarist and Attending Censor were comparable to middle-rank vice director;

sentences.zh: 起居轉兵部、吏部員外郎，侍御史轉職方員外郎，優者為兵部、司封、知制誥；

translations.literal: Diarist transferred to Vice Director of the Ministries of War or Personnel; Attending Censor to Vice Director of the Bureau of Offices; the superior to Ministries of War, Seals, or Drafting Attendant for Edicts;
translations.idiomatic: Diarist transferred to Vice Director of the Ministries of War or Personnel; Attending Censor to Vice Director of the Bureau of Offices; the superior to Ministries of War, Seals, or Drafting Attendant for Edicts;

sentences.zh: 由正言以上至郎中，皆敘遷兩資，中行郎中為左右司郎中，若非次酬勞，有遷三資或止一資者；

translations.literal: from Rectifier upward to director, all advanced by regular promotion of two grades; middle-rank directors became Left and Right Department Directors; if rewarded out of turn, some advanced three grades or only one;
translations.idiomatic: from Rectifier upward to director, all advanced by regular promotion of two grades; middle-rank directors became Left and Right Department Directors; if rewarded out of turn, some advanced three grades or only one;

sentences.zh: 至左右司郎中為知制誥若翰林學士者，遷中書舍人，

translations.literal: when Left and Right Department Directors served as Drafting Attendant for Edicts or Hanlin Academician, they transferred to Secretariat Drafter,
translations.idiomatic: when Left and Right Department Directors served as Drafting Attendant for Edicts or Hanlin Academician, they transferred to Secretariat Drafter,

sentences.zh: （舊亦有自前行郎中除者，後兵、吏部止遷諫議。）〉

translations.literal: (Formerly some were also appointed directly from front-rank directors; later the Ministries of War and Personnel promoted only to Remonstrance and Reviser.)
translations.idiomatic: (Formerly some were also appointed directly from front-rank directors; later the Ministries of War and Personnel promoted only to Remonstrance and Reviser.)

sentences.zh: 由中書舍人轉禮部以上侍郎，入丞、郎即越一資以上。

translations.literal: from Secretariat Drafter to Vice Minister of Rites and above; entering vice director or director skipped one grade or more.
translations.idiomatic: from Secretariat Drafter to Vice Minister of Rites and above; entering vice director or director skipped one grade or more.

sentences.zh: （內職、學士、待制亦如之。）〉

translations.literal: (Inner-circuit posts, academicians, and draft attendant-compilers followed the same rule.)
translations.idiomatic: (Inner-circuit posts, academicians, and draft attendant-compilers followed the same rule.)

sentences.zh: 御史中丞由諫議轉者遷工部侍郎，由給事轉者遷禮部侍郎，由丞、郎改者約本資焉。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief transferred from Remonstrance and Reviser advanced to Vice Minister of Works; from Drafting Attendant to Vice Minister of Rites; those changed from vice director or director approximated their original seniority.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief transferred from Remonstrance and Reviser advanced to Vice Minister of Works; from Drafting Attendant to Vice Minister of Rites; those changed from vice director or director approximated their original seniority.

sentences.zh: 其學官，司業視少卿，祭酒視大卿。

translations.literal: For academic officials, Vice Rector was comparable to vice director; Rector to grand director.
translations.idiomatic: For academic officials, Vice Rector was comparable to vice director; Rector to grand director.

sentences.zh: 其法官，大理正視中允、讚善。

translations.literal: For judicial officials, Director of the Court of Judicial Review was comparable to Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household or Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: For judicial officials, Director of the Court of Judicial Review was comparable to Vice Director in the Heir Apparent's Household or Tutor.

sentences.zh: 凡正言、監察以上，皆特恩或被舉方除。

translations.literal: All Rectifier and Investigating Censor and above were appointed only by special grace or recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: All Rectifier and Investigating Censor and above were appointed only by special grace or recommendation.

sentences.zh: 其任館閣、三司、王府職事，開封府判官、推官，江淮發運、諸路轉運使、提點刑獄，皆得優遷，或以勤效特獎者亦如之。

translations.literal: Those serving in the Hall of Literature, the Three Fiscal Commissions, princely household substantive posts, judicial administrators and investigating officials of Kaifeng Prefecture, Yangzi-Huai transport commissioners, circuit transport commissioners, and judicial intendant commissioners all received preferential advancement; those specially rewarded for diligent achievement likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Those serving in the Hall of Literature, the Three Fiscal Commissions, princely household substantive posts, judicial administrators and investigating officials of Kaifeng Prefecture, Yangzi-Huai transport commissioners, circuit transport commissioners, and judicial intendant commissioners all received preferential advancement; those specially rewarded for diligent achievement likewise.

sentences.zh: 兩製、龍圖閣、三館皆不帶御史台官，樞密直學士、三司副使皆不帶御史台官及兩省官，待制以上不帶少卿、監。

translations.literal: Drafters of both Secretariats, Dragon Diagram Hall, and the Three Institutes all did not carry concurrent Censorate posts; Privy Council Direct Academicians and Vice Commissioners of the Three Fiscal Commissions did not carry concurrent Censorate or Secretariat posts; draft attendant-compilers and above did not carry concurrent vice director or commissioner posts.
translations.idiomatic: Drafters of both Secretariats, Dragon Diagram Hall, and the Three Institutes did not carry concurrent Censorate posts; Privy Council Direct Academicians and Vice Commissioners of the Three Fiscal Commissions did not carry concurrent Censorate or Secretariat posts; draft attendant-compilers and above did not carry concurrent vice director or commissioner posts.

sentences.zh: 其內職，自借職以上皆循資而遷，至東頭供奉官者轉閣門祗候，閣門祗候轉內殿崇班，崇班轉承製，承製轉諸司副使，自副使以上，或一資，或五資、七資，或直為正使者，至正使亦如之。
