translations.literal: For inner-service posts, from provisional rank upward all advanced by seniority; upon reaching Eastern Hall Attendant Officer one transferred to Gatehouse Usher; Gatehouse Usher to Inner Hall Honored Corps; Honored Corps to Draft Artisan; Draft Artisan to Vice Commissioner of Various Offices; from Vice Commissioner upward, one might advance one grade, or five or seven grades, or directly become full commissioner; reaching full commissioner followed the same pattern.
translations.idiomatic: For inner-service posts, from provisional rank upward all advanced by seniority; upon reaching Eastern Hall Attendant Officer one transferred to Gatehouse Usher; Gatehouse Usher to Inner Hall Honored Corps; Honored Corps to Draft Artisan; Draft Artisan to Vice Commissioner of Various Offices; from Vice Commissioner upward, one might advance one grade, or five or seven grades, or directly become full commissioner; reaching full commissioner followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 至皇城使者轉昭宣使，昭宣使轉宣慶使，宣慶使轉景福殿使。

translations.literal: Upon reaching Imperial City Commissioner one transferred to Commissioner for Brilliant Proclamation; Commissioner for Brilliant Proclamation to Commissioner for Proclaiming Celebration; Commissioner for Proclaiming Celebration to Commissioner of the Hall of Glorious Blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Upon reaching Imperial City Commissioner one transferred to Commissioner for Brilliant Proclamation; Commissioner for Brilliant Proclamation to Commissioner for Proclaiming Celebration; Commissioner for Proclaiming Celebration to Commissioner of the Hall of Glorious Blessings.

sentences.zh: 其閣門祗候，特恩轉通事舍人，通事舍人轉西上閣門副使，亦有加諸司副使兼通事者；

translations.literal: For Gatehouse Ushers, by special grace one transferred to Herald Master of Ceremonies; Herald Master of Ceremonies to Western Upper Gatehouse Vice Commissioner; some also received concurrent Vice Commissioner of Various Offices with Herald duties;
translations.idiomatic: For Gatehouse Ushers, by special grace one transferred to Herald Master of Ceremonies; Herald Master of Ceremonies to Western Upper Gatehouse Vice Commissioner; some also received concurrent Vice Commissioner of Various Offices with Herald duties;

sentences.zh: 西上閣門副使轉東上，東上轉引進，引進轉客省，客省轉西上閣門使；

translations.literal: Western Upper Gatehouse Vice Commissioner transferred to Eastern Upper; Eastern Upper to Commissioner for Introducing Tribute; Introducing Tribute to Guest Reception; Guest Reception to Western Upper Gatehouse Commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Western Upper Gatehouse Vice Commissioner transferred to Eastern Upper; Eastern Upper to Commissioner for Introducing Tribute; Introducing Tribute to Guest Reception; Guest Reception to Western Upper Gatehouse Commissioner;

sentences.zh: 自此以上，亦如副使之遷，惟至東上者又轉四方館使。

translations.literal: From this point upward, advancement likewise followed the Vice Commissioner's pattern; only upon reaching Eastern Upper did one also transfer to Commissioner of the Four Directions Hall.
translations.idiomatic: From this point upward, advancement likewise followed the Vice Commissioner's pattern; only upon reaching Eastern Upper did one also transfer to Commissioner of the Four Directions Hall.

sentences.zh: 客省使轉內客省使，內客省使轉宣徽使，或出為觀察使。

translations.literal: Guest Reception Commissioner transferred to Inner Guest Reception Commissioner; Inner Guest Reception Commissioner to Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Attendants; or one went out as observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Guest Reception Commissioner transferred to Inner Guest Reception Commissioner; Inner Guest Reception Commissioner to Commissioner of the Bureau of Palace Attendants; or one went out as observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 自內客省使以上，非特恩不授。

translations.literal: From Inner Guest Reception Commissioner upward, none were appointed except by special grace.
translations.idiomatic: From Inner Guest Reception Commissioner upward, none were appointed except by special grace.

sentences.zh: 武班副率以上至上將軍，其遷曆軍衛如諸司使副焉。

translations.literal: From Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Military Class upward to General-in-Chief, their advancement through the guard commands followed the pattern of vice and full commissioners of various offices.
translations.idiomatic: From Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Military Class upward to General-in-Chief, advancement through the guard commands followed the pattern of vice and full commissioners of various offices.

sentences.zh: 由牧伯內職改授，則觀察使以上為上將軍，團練使、閣門使以上為大將軍，刺史、諸司使至崇班為將軍，閣門祗候、供奉官為率，殿直以上為副率。

translations.literal: When changed from regional governor or inner-service post, observation commissioner and above became General-in-Chief; training commissioner or gatehouse commissioner and above became Grand General; prefect or commissioner of various offices down to Honored Corps became General; Gatehouse Usher or Attendant Officer became Commander-in-Chief; Palace Attendant and above became Deputy Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: When changed from regional governor or inner-service post, observation commissioner and above became General-in-Chief; training commissioner or gatehouse commissioner and above became Grand General; prefect or commissioner of various offices down to Honored Corps became General; Gatehouse Usher or Attendant Officer became Commander-in-Chief; Palace Attendant and above became Deputy Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 內侍省、入內內侍省，自小黃門至內供奉官，皆曆級而轉，至內東頭供奉官轉內殿崇班，有轉內侍、常侍者，內常侍亦正轉崇班。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant Service and the Inner Palace Attendant Service, from Junior Yellow Gate Attendant to Inner Attendant Officer, all transferred by successive grades; upon reaching Inner Eastern Hall Attendant Officer one transferred to Inner Hall Honored Corps; for those who transferred to Palace Attendant or Regular Attendant, Inner Regular Attendant likewise directly transferred to Honored Corps.
translations.idiomatic: In the Palace Attendant Service and the Inner Palace Attendant Service, from Junior Yellow Gate Attendant through Inner Attendant Officer, all advanced by successive grades. Upon reaching Inner Eastern Hall Attendant Officer one transferred to Inner Hall Honored Corps; those who became Palace Attendants or Regular Attendants likewise advanced directly to Honored Corps.

sentences.zh: 其銓選之製：兩府司錄，次赤令，留守、兩府、節度、觀察判官，少尹，一選；

translations.literal: The system of selection appraisal: recording secretaries of the two metropolitan prefectures, secondary capital county magistrates, judicial administrators of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, military commissioners, and surveillance commissioners, and Vice Prefects, one selection round;
translations.idiomatic: The selection system worked as follows: recording secretaries of the two metropolitan prefectures, secondary capital county magistrates, and judicial administrators of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, military commissioners, and surveillance commissioners, as well as Vice Prefects, required one selection round;

sentences.zh: 兩府判、司，兩畿令，掌書記，支使，防禦、團練判官，二選；

translations.literal: judicial administrators and section officers of the two metropolitan prefectures, capital-district county magistrates, secretarial recorders, staff envoys, and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners, two selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: judicial administrators and section officers of the two metropolitan prefectures, capital-district county magistrates, secretarial recorders, staff envoys, and judicial administrators of defense and training commissioners required two selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 諸府司、錄，次畿令，四赤簿、尉，軍事判官，留守、兩府、節度、觀察、防禦、團練軍事推官，軍、監判官，進士、製舉，三選；

translations.literal: section officers and recording secretaries of various prefectures, secondary capital-district county magistrates, registrars and vice magistrates of the four secondary capitals, military judicial administrators, investigating officials of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, military commissioners, surveillance commissioners, defense commissioners, and training commissioners, judicial administrators of army and supervisory posts, presented scholars and special-examination graduates, three selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: section officers and recording secretaries of various prefectures, secondary capital-district county magistrates, registrars and vice magistrates of the four secondary capitals, military judicial administrators, investigating officials of commissioners in residence, the two metropolitan prefectures, military and surveillance commissioners, defense and training commissioners, and judicial administrators of army and supervisory posts, together with presented scholars and special-examination graduates, required three selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 諸府司理、判、司，望縣令，《九經》，四選；

translations.literal: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of various prefectures, upper-tier county magistrates, and examinees of the 《Nine Classics》, four selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of various prefectures, upper-tier county magistrates, and examinees of the 《Nine Classics》, required four selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 輔州、大都督府司理、判、司，緊上州錄事參軍，緊上縣令，次赤兩畿簿、尉，《五經》、《三禮》、《三傳》、《三史》、《通禮》、明法，五選；

translations.literal: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of auxiliary prefectures and great protectorate prefectures, recording secretaries of highest tight-rank prefectures, magistrates of highest tight-rank counties, registrars and vice magistrates of secondary capitals and the two capital districts, and examinees of the 《Five Classics》, 《Three Rites》, 《Three Commentaries》, 《Three Histories》, 《Comprehensive Rites》, and legal code, five selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of auxiliary prefectures and great protectorate prefectures, recording secretaries of highest tight-rank prefectures, magistrates of highest tight-rank counties, registrars and vice magistrates of secondary capitals and the two capital districts, and examinees of the 《Five Classics》, 《Three Rites》, 《Three Commentaries》, 《Three Histories》, 《Comprehensive Rites》, and legal code required five selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 雄望州司理、判、司，中州錄事參軍，中縣令，次畿簿、尉，六選；

translations.literal: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of grand upper-tier prefectures, recording secretaries of middle-rank prefectures, middle-rank county magistrates, and secondary capital-district registrars and vice magistrates, six selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of grand upper-tier prefectures, recording secretaries of middle-rank prefectures, middle-rank county magistrates, and secondary capital-district registrars and vice magistrates required six selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 緊上州司理、判、司，下州、中下州錄事參軍，中下縣、下縣令，緊望縣簿、尉，學究，七選；

translations.literal: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of highest tight-rank prefectures, recording secretaries of lower and lower-middle prefectures, magistrates of lower-middle and lower counties, registrars and vice magistrates of tight upper-tier counties, and classicists, seven selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of highest tight-rank prefectures, recording secretaries of lower and lower-middle prefectures, magistrates of lower-middle and lower counties, registrars and vice magistrates of tight upper-tier counties, and classicists required seven selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 中州中下州司理、判、司，上縣簿、尉，八選；

translations.literal: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of middle and lower-middle prefectures, and registrars and vice magistrates of upper counties, eight selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of middle and lower-middle prefectures, and registrars and vice magistrates of upper counties, required eight selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 下州司理、判、司，中縣簿、尉，九選；

translations.literal: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of lower prefectures, and registrars and vice magistrates of middle counties, nine selection rounds;
translations.idiomatic: judicial affairs administrators, judicial administrators, and section officers of lower prefectures, and registrars and vice magistrates of middle counties, required nine selection rounds;

sentences.zh: 中下縣下縣簿、尉，十選。

translations.literal: registrars and vice magistrates of lower-middle and lower counties, ten selection rounds.
translations.idiomatic: registrars and vice magistrates of lower-middle and lower counties required ten selection rounds.

sentences.zh: 太廟齋郎、室長通理九年，郊社齋郎、掌坐通理十一年。

translations.literal: Temple of Ancestors Acolytes and chamber chiefs counted together nine years; Suburban Sacrifice Acolytes and seat attendants counted together eleven years.
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Ancestors Acolytes and chamber chiefs counted their service together as nine years; Suburban Sacrifice Acolytes and seat attendants counted together as eleven years.

sentences.zh: 凡入官，則進士入望州判司、次畿簿尉，《九經》入緊州判司、望縣簿尉，《五經》、《三禮》、《通禮》、《三傳》、《三史》、明法入上州判司、緊縣簿尉，學究有出身人入中州判司、上縣簿尉，太廟齋郎入中下州判司、中縣簿尉，郊社齋郎、試銜無出身人入下州判司、中下縣簿尉，諸司入流人入下州判司、下縣簿尉。

translations.literal: For all entering office: presented scholars entered as judicial administrators and section officers in upper-tier prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in secondary capital districts; examinees of the 《Nine Classics》 entered as judicial administrators and section officers in tight-rank prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in upper-tier counties; examinees of the 《Five Classics》, 《Three Rites》, 《Comprehensive Rites》, 《Three Commentaries》, 《Three Histories》, and legal code entered as judicial administrators and section officers in upper-rank prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in tight-rank counties; classicists with examination standing entered as judicial administrators and section officers in middle-rank prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in upper counties; Temple of Ancestors Acolytes entered as judicial administrators and section officers in lower-middle prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in middle counties; Suburban Sacrifice Acolytes and those with provisional titles but no examination standing entered as judicial administrators and section officers in lower prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in lower-middle counties; and various-office entrants to the regular stream entered as judicial administrators and section officers in lower prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in lower counties.
translations.idiomatic: On first entering office, presented scholars were assigned as judicial administrators and section officers in upper-tier prefectures or as registrars and vice magistrates in secondary capital districts. Examinees of the 《Nine Classics》 took judicial administrator and section officer posts in tight-rank prefectures or registrar and vice magistrate posts in upper-tier counties. Examinees of the 《Five Classics》, 《Three Rites》, 《Comprehensive Rites》, 《Three Commentaries》, 《Three Histories》, and legal code took posts in upper-rank prefectures or tight-rank counties. Classicists with examination standing went to middle-rank prefectures or upper counties. Temple of Ancestors Acolytes went to lower-middle prefectures or middle counties. Suburban Sacrifice Acolytes and holders of provisional titles without examination standing went to lower prefectures or lower-middle counties. Entrants to the regular stream from various offices went to lower prefectures or lower counties.

sentences.zh: 仁宗初，吏員猶簡，吏部奏天下幕職、州縣官期滿無代者八百餘員，而川、廣尤多未代。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Renzong's reign, the roster of officials was still lean; the Ministry of Personnel reported that more than eight hundred secretariat staff and prefectural and county officials empire-wide had completed their terms without replacements, and in Sichuan and Guang especially many had no successors.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Renzong's reign the official roster was still lean, yet the Ministry of Personnel reported that more than eight hundred secretariat staff and prefectural and county officials empire-wide had finished their terms without replacements. In Sichuan and Guang the backlog was especially severe.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：“此豈人情之所樂耶？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Is this something people would willingly accept?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Surely no one would willingly endure this?

sentences.zh: 其亟代之。

translations.literal: Replace them at once.
translations.idiomatic: Replace them at once.

sentences.zh: ”帝御後殿視事，或至旰食。

translations.literal: " The Emperor held court in the rear hall and sometimes worked until the late meal.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor held court in the rear hall and sometimes worked so late that dinner was delayed.

sentences.zh: 中書請如天禧舊制，審官、三班院、流內銓日引見毋得過兩人，詔弗許。

translations.literal: The Secretariat requested that, following the old Tianxi system, the Office for Review of Appointments, the Third-Class Hall, and the Within-the-Stream Selection present no more than two persons per day for audience, but an edict did not permit this.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat asked to restore the old Tianxi rule limiting the Office for Review of Appointments, the Third-Class Hall, and the Within-the-Stream Selection to presenting no more than two candidates per day for imperial audience, but the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 自真宗朝，試身、言、書、判者第推恩，乃特詔曰：“國家詳核吏治，念其或淹常選，而以四事程其能。

translations.literal: From Emperor Zhenzong's reign, those examined in physique, speech, calligraphy, and judgment received only graded grace; then a special edict stated: "The state scrutinizes governance closely, mindful that some may be stalled in the regular selection and therefore tests their ability in four matters.
translations.idiomatic: Since Emperor Zhenzong's reign, candidates tested in physique, speech, calligraphy, and judgment had received only graded promotions. Now a special edict declared, "The state scrutinizes official performance closely. Knowing that some candidates languish in the regular selection process, we test their ability in four areas.

sentences.zh: 朕承統緒，循用舊典，爰命從臣，精加詳考。

translations.literal: I have received the imperial succession and follow the old statutes, and therefore command my attendant ministers to examine this with careful scrutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Having received the imperial succession, I follow established precedent and command my ministers to examine candidates with the greatest care.

sentences.zh: 其令翰林學士李諮與吏部流內銓以成資闕為差擬。

translations.literal: Let Hanlin Academician Li Zou and the Ministry of Personnel's Within-the-Stream Selection draw up assignments according to fully qualified vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: Let Hanlin Academician Li Zou and the Ministry of Personnel's Within-the-Stream Selection draw up assignments from fully qualified vacancies.

sentences.zh: ”於是鹹得遷官，率以為常。

translations.literal: " Thereafter all received office advancement, and this generally became the norm.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter all who passed were promoted, and the practice soon became routine.

sentences.zh: 後議者以身、言、書、判為無益，乃罷。

translations.literal: Later critics held that physique, speech, calligraphy, and judgment were useless, and the practice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later critics argued that testing physique, speech, calligraphy, and judgment served no purpose, and the practice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 凡磨勘遷京官，始增四考為六考，舉者四人為五人，曾犯過又加一考。

translations.literal: For all merit reviews leading to promotion to capital official, the initial requirement was raised from four appraisals to six appraisals, recommenders from four to five, and one more appraisal was added for those who had once committed an offense.
translations.idiomatic: For merit reviews leading to promotion to capital official rank, the requirement was raised from four appraisals to six, the number of recommenders from four to five, and one additional appraisal was required of anyone who had previously committed an offense.

sentences.zh: 舉吏各有等數，得被舉者須有本部監司、長吏按察官，乃得磨勘；

translations.literal: Recommending officials each had fixed quotas; those recommended had to include circuit commissioners, chief officials, or inspecting officials of their home jurisdiction before they could receive merit review;
translations.idiomatic: Each recommending official had a fixed quota, and a candidate needed recommendations from circuit commissioners, chief officials, or inspecting officials of his home jurisdiction before he could undergo merit review;

sentences.zh: 須到官一考，方許薦任。

translations.literal: one appraisal after taking office was required before recommendation was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: and one full appraisal after taking office was required before anyone could recommend him.

sentences.zh: 凡選人年二十五以上，遇郊，限半年赴銓試，命兩製三員鎖試於尚書省，糊名謄錄。

translations.literal: For all candidates twenty-five years and above, upon a suburban sacrifice, within half a year they were to attend the selection examination; three drafters of edicts were appointed to conduct a sealed examination at the Ministry office, with names covered and records copied.
translations.idiomatic: All candidates twenty-five and older, when a suburban sacrifice occurred, had half a year to take the selection examination. Three drafters of edicts were appointed to conduct a sealed examination at the Ministry office, with names concealed and papers copied for grading.

sentences.zh: 習辭業者試論、試詩賦，詞理可采、不違程式為中格，習經業者人專一經，兼試律，十而通五為中格，聽預選。

translations.literal: Those trained in literary studies were tested on essays and regulated verse; if their language and reasoning were acceptable and they did not violate the form, they passed at the middle grade. Those trained in classical studies each specialized in one classic and were also tested in law; passing five of ten counted as the middle grade, and they were permitted preliminary selection.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates trained in literary studies were tested on essays and regulated verse; acceptable reasoning within proper form earned a middle pass. Those trained in classical studies specialized in one classic and were also tested in law; answering five of ten correctly earned a middle pass and qualified them for preliminary selection.

sentences.zh: 七選以上經三試至選滿，京朝官保任者三人，補遠地判、司、簿、尉，無舉主者補司士參軍，或不赴試、亦無舉者，永不預選。

translations.literal: Those of seven selection rounds and above, after three examinations through completion of selection, with three capital court officials as guarantors, were assigned to distant posts as judicial administrators, section officers, registrars, or vice magistrates; those without recommenders were assigned as Registry Officers; those who did not attend the examination and also had no recommenders were never again permitted preliminary selection.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates who had completed seven selection rounds and passed three examinations, with three capital court officials as guarantors, were assigned to distant posts as judicial administrators, section officers, registrars, or vice magistrates. Those without recommenders became Registry Officers. Anyone who skipped the examination and lacked recommenders was permanently barred from preliminary selection.

sentences.zh: 京官年二十五以上，歲首赴試於國子監，考法如選人，中格者調官。

translations.literal: Capital officials twenty-five years and above, at the year's beginning, attended examination at the Directorate of Education; the testing method was the same as for candidates, and those passing at the middle grade received office assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials twenty-five and older took the examination at the Directorate of Education at the start of each year under the same rules as selection candidates; those who passed at the middle grade received new assignments.

sentences.zh: 兩任無私罪而有部使、州守倅舉者五人，入親民；

translations.literal: after two terms without private offenses and with five recommenders who were circuit commissioners, prefects, or vice prefects, they entered posts dealing directly with the people;
translations.idiomatic: After two terms without private offenses and with five recommendations from circuit commissioners, prefects, or vice prefects, they were assigned to posts dealing directly with the people;

sentences.zh: 舉者三人，惟與下等厘物務官。

translations.literal: with three recommenders, they received only lower-grade revenue and supplies posts.
translations.idiomatic: with three recommenders they received only lower-grade revenue and supplies posts.

sentences.zh: 初，州郡多闕官，縣令選尤猥下，多為清流所鄙薄，每不得調。

translations.literal: Initially, prefectures and commanderies had many vacancies; the pool for county magistrates was especially base, and they were often despised by the elite current, frequently receiving no assignment.
translations.idiomatic: At first many prefectures and commanderies lacked officials, and the county magistrate pool was especially low in quality. Elite officials looked down on such posts, and candidates often failed to secure assignments.

sentences.zh: 乃詔吏部選幕職官為知縣，又立舉任法以重令選，敕諸路察縣之不治者。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the Ministry of Personnel to select secretariat staff officials as county magistrates with full authority, established a recommendation appointment law to give weight to the magistrate pool, and commanded the various circuits to investigate poorly governed counties.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered the Ministry of Personnel to appoint secretariat staff officials as county magistrates with full authority, established a recommendation law to elevate the magistrate pool, and commanded each circuit to investigate poorly governed counties.

sentences.zh: 然被舉者日益眾，有司無闕以待之，中書奏罷舉縣令法。

translations.literal: However, those recommended grew daily in number, and the responsible offices had no vacancies to await them; the Secretariat memorialized to abolish the law for recommending county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: But recommended candidates grew so numerous that responsible offices lacked vacancies for them all, and the Secretariat memorialized to abolish the county magistrate recommendation law.

sentences.zh: 未幾，有言親民之任輕，則有害於治，法不宜廢。

translations.literal: Before long, some said that if posts dealing directly with the people were treated lightly, governance would suffer, and the law should not be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Before long critics argued that treating posts dealing directly with the people too lightly would harm governance and that the law should not be abolished.

sentences.zh: 復令指劇縣奏舉，舉者二人，必一人本部使，既居任，復有舉者，始得遷，否則如常選，毋輒升補。

translations.literal: It was again ordered that difficult counties be designated for memorial recommendation; there were to be two recommenders, one of whom had to be the circuit commissioner of the home jurisdiction; once in office, further recommendation was required before promotion; otherwise they followed regular selection and were not casually advanced.
translations.idiomatic: The court again ordered that difficult counties be designated for memorial recommendation. Two recommenders were required, one of them the circuit commissioner of the candidate's jurisdiction. Once in office, further recommendation was needed before promotion; otherwise the official followed the regular selection process and could not be casually advanced.

sentences.zh: 常參官已授外任，勿奏舉。

translations.literal: Regular court attendees who had already received outside appointments were not to be memorialized for recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: Regular court attendees who had already received outside appointments were not to be recommended by memorial.

sentences.zh: 然銓格煩密，府史奸弊尤多，而磨勘者待次外州，或經三二歲乃得改官，往往因緣薄勞，求截甲引見。

translations.literal: However, the selection regulations were intricate, bureau clerks engaged in especially many corrupt practices, and those awaiting merit review queued in outside prefectures, sometimes waiting two or three years before office change; they often exploited meager service records to seek cutting ahead in register order for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the selection regulations were intricate, bureau clerks corrupt, and officials awaiting merit review often queued in outside prefectures for two or three years before promotion. Many exploited thin records of service to cut ahead in the register and obtain imperial audience.

sentences.zh: 有詔自是弗許。

translations.literal: An edict thereafter did not permit this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict thereafter forbade the practice.

sentences.zh: 神宗欲更制度，建議之臣以為唐銓與今選殊異，雜用其製，則有留礙煩紊之弊。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong wished to reform the institutions; proposing ministers held that the Tang selection system differed greatly from the present selection, and that mixing its institutions would create impediments and confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong wished to reform the institutions. Ministers who proposed changes argued that the Tang selection system differed greatly from the present one and that mixing the two would create obstruction and confusion.

sentences.zh: 始刊削舊條，務從簡便，因廢南曹而並歸之於銓。

translations.literal: They began to revise and pare down old regulations, striving for simplicity and convenience, and abolished the Southern Bureau, merging it into the selection office.
translations.idiomatic: They began revising old regulations for simplicity and convenience, abolished the Southern Bureau, and merged its functions into the selection office.

sentences.zh: 初，審官西院與東院對掌文武，尋改從吏部，而左、右選分焉。

translations.literal: Initially, the Western Hall and Eastern Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments jointly managed civil and military affairs; soon they were placed under the Ministry of Personnel, and the Left and Right Selections were divided accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Initially the Western and Eastern Halls of the Office for Review of Appointments jointly handled civil and military selection. They were later placed under the Ministry of Personnel and divided into Left and Right Selection.

sentences.zh: 祖宗以來，中書有堂選，百司、郡縣有奏舉，雖小大殊科，然皆不隸於有司。

translations.literal: Since the dynastic founders, the Secretariat had Secretariat selection, and the various offices, commanderies, and counties had memorial recommendation; though great and small differed in category, none belonged to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the dynasty, the Secretariat had exercised Secretariat selection, and the various offices, commanderies, and counties had used memorial recommendation. Though the categories differed in rank, none fell under the regular selection offices.

sentences.zh: 暨元豐罷奏舉闕，屬之銓曹，而堂選亦不領於中書，一時更製，必欲公天下而詒永久。

translations.literal: When Yuanfeng abolished memorial-recommendation vacancies and assigned them to the Selection Department, and Secretariat selection was also no longer managed by the Secretariat, the institutions were changed at once, aiming to make appointments public throughout the realm and secure permanence.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanfeng reforms memorial-recommendation vacancies were assigned to the Selection Department and Secretariat selection was removed from the Secretariat. The institutions were changed at a stroke, aiming to open appointments to the realm and establish lasting order.

sentences.zh: 於是除免選之恩，重出官之試，定賞罰之則，酌資蔭之宜。

translations.literal: Thereupon grace exempting from selection wait was removed, the examination for first office was strengthened, rules of reward and punishment were fixed, and the proper measure of yin privilege by family status was weighed.
translations.idiomatic: Grace exempting candidates from the selection wait was abolished, the examination for first office was strengthened, rules of reward and punishment were fixed, and the proper scope of yin privilege was determined.

sentences.zh: 凡設試以待命士而入之銓注者，自蔭補、銓試之外，有進士律義、武臣呈試及試刑法官等，而銓試所受為特廣。

translations.literal: For all examinations set to await appointed scholars entering selection assignment, apart from yin supplementation and selection examination, there were presented-scholar legal principles, military officials' presentation examination, and judicial examination, among others; but the selection examination received candidates on an especially broad scale.
translations.idiomatic: Examinations awaited those entering selection assignment: apart from yin supplementation and the selection examination itself, there were tests in legal principles for presented scholars, presentation examinations for military officials, and judicial examinations, among others. But the selection examination drew by far the widest pool of candidates.

sentences.zh: 中書言：“選人守選，有及三年方遇恩放選者，或適歸選而遽遇恩，既為不均，且蔭補免試注官，以不習事多失職，試者又止試詩，豈足甄才？

translations.literal: The Secretariat stated: "Candidates awaiting selection: some waited as long as three years before encountering grace and release for selection; others had just returned for selection when grace suddenly arrived -- this was already unequal. Moreover, yin supplementation exempted from examination and granted office, yet because they were unskilled many failed in duty; and those examined were tested only in poetry -- how could that discern talent?
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat reported, "Some candidates awaiting selection waited three years before a grace amnesty released them; others had just returned when grace arrived unexpectedly. The system was already unequal. Yin supplementation exempted candidates from examination, yet many appointees failed because they lacked experience. Those who were tested faced only a poetry examination. How could that identify talent?

sentences.zh: 已受任而無勞績，舉薦及免試恩法，須再試書判三道，然亦虛文。

translations.literal: Those already appointed without merit records, by recommendation and grace laws exempting examination, had to be retested on three document judgments, yet this too was empty form.
translations.idiomatic: Those already appointed without records of achievement, whether through recommendation or grace laws exempting examination, had to retake three document-judgment questions, yet even that was empty formality.

sentences.zh: 熙寧四年，遂定銓試之製：凡守選者，歲以二月、八月試斷按二，或律令大義五，或議三道，後增試經義。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xining, the selection examination system was fixed: for all awaiting selection, in the second and eighth months each year they were tested on two case briefs, or five essential principles of statutes and ordinances, or three policy essays; later classic meaning was added to the examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xining the selection examination was fixed. All candidates awaiting selection were tested each February and August on two case briefs, or five essential principles of statutes and ordinances, or three policy essays. Classic meaning was later added to the examination.

sentences.zh: 差官同銓曹撰式考試，第為三等，上等免選注官，優等升資如判超格，無出身者賜之出身。

translations.literal: Officials were dispatched to join the Selection Department in drafting the examination form; grades were divided into three ranks: the upper rank was exempted from selection wait and granted office; the superior rank received promotion of seniority as if judgment exceeded grade; those without examination standing were granted standing.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to join the Selection Department in setting the examination. Results were divided into three grades: the top grade exempted candidates from the selection wait and granted immediate office; the superior grade advanced seniority as if judgment exceeded grade; those without examination standing received it.

sentences.zh: 自是不復試判，仍去免選恩格，若曆任有舉者五人，自與免試注官。

translations.literal: From this time document judgment was no longer tested, and the grace regulation exempting selection wait was also removed; if through successive terms there were five recommenders, one was automatically exempted from examination and granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter document judgment was no longer tested and the grace regulation exempting the selection wait was abolished. Anyone with five recommenders across successive terms was automatically exempted from examination and granted office.

sentences.zh: 任子年及二十，聽赴銓試。

translations.literal: Sons receiving yin privilege who reached twenty years were permitted to attend the selection examination.
translations.idiomatic: Sons receiving yin privilege who reached twenty were permitted to take the selection examination.

sentences.zh: 其試不中或不能試，選人滿三歲許注官，惟不得入縣令、司理、司法。

translations.literal: If they failed the examination or could not take it, after candidates completed three years they were permitted office assignment, but could not enter county magistrate, judicial administrator, or judicial-review posts.
translations.idiomatic: Those who failed or could not take the examination were permitted office assignment after three years as candidates, but could not become county magistrates, judicial administrators, or judicial-review officials.

sentences.zh: 任子年及三十方許參注，若年及三十授官，已及三年，出官亦不用試。

translations.literal: Sons receiving yin privilege were permitted to participate in assignment only upon reaching thirty; if at thirty they received office and had already completed three years, first office also required no examination.
translations.idiomatic: Sons receiving yin privilege could participate in assignment only at thirty. If appointed at thirty after three years' waiting, they also needed no examination for first office.

sentences.zh: 若秩入京朝，即展任監當三年，在任有二人薦之，免展。

translations.literal: If upon rank they entered capital court service, they had to extend supervisory custody for three years; if while in office two persons recommended them, the extension was waived.
translations.idiomatic: If promoted to capital court rank, they had to extend supervisory custody for three years, unless two persons recommended them while in office, in which case the extension was waived.

sentences.zh: 選人應改官，必對便殿。

translations.literal: Candidates due for office change had to appear before the Convenient Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates due for promotion had to appear for audience in the Convenient Hall.

sentences.zh: 舊制，五日一引，不過二人。

translations.literal: Under the old system, audience was held every five days, with no more than two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system audience was held every five days, with no more than two candidates presented.

sentences.zh: 至是，待次者多，有逾二年乃得引。

translations.literal: At this time those awaiting their turn were many, and some waited more than two years before receiving audience.
translations.idiomatic: By this time so many candidates were waiting that some queued more than two years before receiving audience.

sentences.zh: 帝閔其留滯，詔每甲引四人以便之。

translations.literal: The Emperor pitied their delay and edicted that four persons per register cohort be presented for audience to ease the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Pitying their delay, the Emperor ordered that four candidates per register cohort be presented for audience to speed the process.

sentences.zh: 帝因論郡守，謂宰臣曰：“朕每思祖宗百戰得天下，今州郡付之庸人，常切痛心。

translations.literal: The Emperor, discussing prefects, said to the chief ministers: "I often reflect that our ancestors won the realm through a hundred battles, yet today prefectures and commanderies are entrusted to mediocre men -- this constantly pains me deeply.
translations.idiomatic: While discussing prefects, the Emperor said to his chief ministers, "I often reflect that our ancestors won the realm through a hundred battles, yet today we entrust prefectures and commanderies to mediocre men. That constantly grieves me.

sentences.zh: 卿輩謂何如而得選任之要？

translations.literal: What do you say is the key to obtaining proper selection and appointment?
translations.idiomatic: What do you consider the key to proper selection and appointment?

sentences.zh: ”文彥博請擇監司而按察之。

translations.literal: " Wen Yanbo requested selecting supervisory commissioners to inspect them.
translations.idiomatic: " Wen Yanbo proposed selecting supervisory commissioners to inspect them.

sentences.zh: 陳升之曰：“取難治劇郡，擇審官近臣而責以選才，宜可得也。

translations.literal: Chen Sheng-zhi said: "Take difficult and hard-to-govern commanderies, select close ministers from the Office for Review of Appointments, and charge them with selecting talent -- suitable men should be obtainable.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Sheng-zhi said, "Take the hardest commanderies to govern, select close ministers from the Office for Review of Appointments, and charge them with finding talent. Suitable men should be obtainable.

sentences.zh: 初置審官西院，磨勘武臣，並如審官院格，而舊審官曰東院。

translations.literal: When the Western Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments was first established, it conducted merit review of military officials, all following the regulations of the Office for Review of Appointments, while the former office was called the Eastern Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the Western Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments was first established, it conducted merit review of military officials under the same regulations as the main office, while the former office was renamed the Eastern Hall.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞呂公著言：“英宗時，文臣磨勘，例展一年，至少卿、監止。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Lü Gongzhu stated: "In Emperor Yingzong's time, civil officials in merit review routinely had one year added, stopping at vice director and director.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Lü Gongzhu said, "Under Emperor Yingzong, civil officials undergoing merit review routinely had one year added to their term, with the limit stopping at vice director and director.

sentences.zh: 武臣橫行以上及使臣，猶循舊制，固未嚐如文臣有所節抑也。

translations.literal: Military officials of hengxing rank and above and envoy-officials still followed the old system and had never, like civil officials, been subject to restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Military officials of hengxing rank and above and envoy-officials still followed the old system and had never faced the restraints applied to civil officials.

sentences.zh: 又仁宗時，嚐著令，正任防禦、團練以上，非邊功不遷。

translations.literal: Moreover, in Emperor Renzong's time, a regulation had been issued that substantive defense and training commissioners and above were not promoted except for frontier merit.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, under Emperor Renzong a regulation had been issued that substantive defense and training commissioners and above could not be promoted without frontier merit.

sentences.zh: 今及十年嚐曆外任，即許轉，亦未如少卿、監之有限止也。

translations.literal: Now after ten years having served outside appointment, transfer was permitted, yet this still lacked the fixed limits applied to vice directors and directors.
translations.idiomatic: Now after ten years of outside service transfer was permitted, yet this still lacked the fixed limits applied to vice directors and directors.

sentences.zh: ”詔兩製詳定。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered drafters of edicts to examine and fix this in detail.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered drafters of edicts to examine the matter in detail.

sentences.zh: 王珪等言：“文武兩選磨勘，已皆均用四年。

translations.literal: Wang Gui and others stated: "Civil and military selection merit reviews already both uniformly use four years.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gui and others reported, "Civil and military merit reviews already both use a uniform four-year term.

sentences.zh: 請今自正任刺史以上，轉官未滿十年，若有顯效者自許特轉，其非次恩惟許改易州鎮，以示旌寵。

translations.literal: We request that from substantive prefect and above, if office transfer had not reached ten years, those with conspicuous achievement be permitted special transfer; out-of-turn grace should be permitted only to change prefecture or commandery assignment, to show honor and favor.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that from substantive prefect upward, if an official has served less than ten years, those with conspicuous achievement may receive special transfer. Out-of-turn grace should be limited to changing prefecture or commandery assignment as a mark of honor.

sentences.zh: 有過，則比文臣展年。

translations.literal: If there was an offense, years should be extended as for civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: If an offense occurred, years should be extended as for civil officials.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 知審官西院李壽朋言：“皇城使占籍者三十餘員，多領遙郡，而尚得從磨勘，遷刺史、團練防禦使。

translations.literal: Director of the Western Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments Li Shoupeng stated: "More than thirty Imperial City Commissioners on register, many holding distant commands, still underwent merit review and were promoted to prefect, training commissioner, or defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shoupeng, director of the Western Hall of the Office for Review of Appointments, reported, "More than thirty Imperial City Commissioners on register, many holding distant honorary commands, still underwent merit review and were promoted to prefect, training commissioner, or defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 每進一級，增奉錢五萬，廩粟雜給如之，實為無名。

translations.literal: Each advance of one grade added fifty thousand in salary cash, with grain rations and miscellaneous allowances likewise -- this was truly without justification.
translations.idiomatic: Each promotion added fifty thousand in salary, with grain rations and allowances likewise. The expense was wholly unjustified.

sentences.zh: 請於皇城使上別置二使名，視前行郎中，量給奉祿。

translations.literal: We request that above Imperial City Commissioner two commissioner titles be separately established, treated as former Langzhong rank, with salary given in measured amount.
translations.idiomatic: We propose establishing two new commissioner titles above Imperial City Commissioner, treated as equivalent to former Langzhong rank, with commensurate salary.

sentences.zh: 其遙郡刺史、團練防禦使，並從朝廷賞功擢用，更不序遷。

translations.literal: Distant-command prefects, training commissioners, and defense commissioners should all be promoted by the court for meritorious service and no longer advance by regular sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Distant-command prefects, training commissioners, and defense commissioners should be promoted by the court for meritorious service and no longer advance by regular sequence.

sentences.zh: ”詔：“遙郡刺史、團練防禦使，並以十年磨勘，至觀察留後止。

translations.literal: " An edict stated: "Distant-command prefects, training commissioners, and defense commissioners all undergo ten-year merit review, stopping at observation commissioner deputy.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict declared, "Distant-command prefects, training commissioners, and defense commissioners all undergo ten-year merit review, with promotion stopping at observation commissioner deputy.

sentences.zh: 應官止而有功若特恩遷者，不以法。

translations.literal: Those whose office should stop but who are promoted for merit or special grace are not bound by this regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Promotions for merit or special grace beyond the prescribed limit are not bound by this regulation.

sentences.zh: 諸司使副，每磨勘皆用常製，雖軍功亦無別異，而閣門內侍輩，轉皆七資。

translations.literal: Commissioners and vice commissioners of various offices, in each merit review, all used the regular system; even military merit had no special distinction. Yet gatehouse attendants and inner attendants advanced by seven grades in every transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners and vice commissioners of various offices all followed the regular merit review system, with no special treatment even for military merit. Yet gatehouse attendants and inner attendants advanced seven grades with every promotion.

sentences.zh: 帝謂：“左右近習，非勳勞而得超躐，至嚐立功者乃無優遷，非製也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Close attendants at left and right, without meritorious service, received leapfrog promotion, while those who had achieved merit received no preferential advancement -- this is not regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Close attendants leapfrogged ranks without meritorious service, while those who had actually achieved merit received no preferential advancement. This is not proper regulation.

sentences.zh: ”使副嚐有軍功應轉，許特超七資，閣門通事舍人、帶禦器械、兩省都知押班、管幹禦藥院使臣七資超轉法，皆除之。

translations.literal: " Vice commissioners who had achieved military merit and deserved transfer were permitted special leapfrog of seven grades; the seven-grade leapfrog methods for Gatehouse Herald Masters of Ceremonies, bearers of imperial arms, heads and ushers of the two inner palaces, and envoy-officials managing the Imperial Pharmacy were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " Vice commissioners with military merit deserving promotion were permitted special advancement of seven grades. The seven-grade leapfrog rules for Gatehouse Herald Masters of Ceremonies, bearers of imperial arms, heads and ushers of the two inner palaces, and envoy-officials of the Imperial Pharmacy were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 後客省、引進、四方館各置使二員，東、西上閣門共置使六員，客省、引進、閣門副使共八員。

translations.literal: Later Guest Reception, Introducing Tribute, and the Four Directions Hall each had two commissioners established; Eastern and Western Upper Gatehouses together had six commissioners established; Guest Reception, Introducing Tribute, and Gatehouse vice commissioners totaled eight posts.
translations.idiomatic: Later Guest Reception, Introducing Tribute, and the Four Directions Hall each received two commissioners; the Eastern and Western Upper Gatehouses together received six commissioners; and Guest Reception, Introducing Tribute, and Gatehouse vice commissioners totaled eight posts.

sentences.zh: 副使磨勘如諸司使法。

translations.literal: Vice commissioners underwent merit review according to the method for commissioners of various offices.
translations.idiomatic: Vice commissioners underwent merit review under the same rules as commissioners of various offices.

sentences.zh: 使有闕，改官及五期者，樞密院檢舉。

translations.literal: When a commissioner post was vacant, those who had changed office and completed five terms were screened by the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When a commissioner post fell vacant, the Bureau of Military Affairs screened candidates who had changed office and completed five terms.

sentences.zh: 曆閣門職事有犯事理重者，當遷日除他官；

translations.literal: Those who while serving Gatehouse duties committed serious offenses, on the day of expected transfer, were dismissed to other offices;
translations.idiomatic: Gatehouse officials who committed serious offenses were reassigned to other posts on the day they would otherwise have been promoted;

sentences.zh: 閣門、四方館使七年無私過，未有闕可遷者，加遙郡；

translations.literal: Gatehouse and Four Directions Hall commissioners who for seven years had no private offenses and for whom no vacancy existed for transfer received distant commands;
translations.idiomatic: Gatehouse and Four Directions Hall commissioners with seven years without private offenses but no vacancy for promotion received distant honorary commands;

sentences.zh: 特旨與正任者，引進四年轉團練使，客省四年轉防禦使：皆著為定制焉。

translations.literal: those granted substantive appointment by special edict: Introducing Tribute transferred to training commissioner in four years, Guest Reception to defense commissioner in four years -- all were fixed as established regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Those granted substantive appointment by special edict transferred from Introducing Tribute to training commissioner in four years and from Guest Reception to defense commissioner in four years. All these rules were fixed as permanent regulation.

sentences.zh: 先是，御史乞罷堂選，曾公亮執不可。

translations.literal: Previously, censors requested abolishing Secretariat selection; Zeng Gongliang insisted it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Previously censors had asked to abolish Secretariat selection, but Zeng Gongliang insisted it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 王安石曰：“中書總庶務，今通判亦該堂選，徒留滯，不能精擇，宜歸之有司。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "The Secretariat oversees all affairs; now even transit intendants fall under Secretariat selection -- this merely causes delay and prevents careful choice; they should be returned to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, "The Secretariat oversees all affairs, yet even transit intendants fall under Secretariat selection. That merely causes delay and prevents careful choice. Such appointments should return to the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“唐陸贄謂：‘宰相當擇百官之長，而百官之長擇百官。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "Tang Lu Zhi said: 'The chief minister should select the heads of the hundred offices, and the heads of the hundred offices should select the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor replied, "Lu Zhi of Tang said, 'The chief minister should select the heads of the hundred offices, and the heads of the hundred offices should select the officials beneath them.

sentences.zh: ’今之審官，苟得其人，安有不能精擇百官者哉？

translations.literal: ' If today's Office for Review of Appointments obtains the right person, how could it fail to select the hundred offices with care?
translations.idiomatic: ' If the Office for Review of Appointments has the right people, how could it fail to select officials with care?

sentences.zh: ”元豐四年，堂選、堂占悉罷。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year of Yuanfeng, Secretariat selection and Secretariat reserved posts were entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth year of Yuanfeng, Secretariat selection and Secretariat reserved posts were entirely abolished.

sentences.zh: 初，有司屬職卑者不在吏銓，率命長吏舉奏。

translations.literal: Initially, low-ranking subordinate posts of responsible offices were not in the Ministry of Personnel selection; the chief officials were generally ordered to recommend and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Initially low-ranking subordinate posts in the various offices did not fall under Ministry of Personnel selection; chief officials were generally ordered to recommend candidates by memorial.

sentences.zh: 都水監主簿李士良言：“沿河干集使臣，凡百六十餘員，悉從水監奏舉，往往不諳水事，幹請得之。

translations.literal: Chief Clerk of the Directorate of Waterways Li Shiliang stated: "Riverine duty envoy-officials along the rivers, more than one hundred sixty in all, were all recommended by memorial from the Waterways Directorate; many did not understand water affairs and obtained posts through solicitation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiliang, chief clerk of the Directorate of Waterways, reported, "More than one hundred sixty riverine duty envoy-officials along the rivers were all recommended by the Waterways Directorate. Many knew nothing of water management and obtained their posts through solicitation.

sentences.zh: ”乃詔東、西審官及三班院選差。

translations.literal: " An edict then ordered the Eastern and Western Halls of the Office for Review of Appointments and the Third-Class Hall to select and assign them.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict then ordered the Eastern and Western Halls of the Office for Review of Appointments and the Third-Class Hall to select and assign them.

sentences.zh: 於是悉罷內外長吏舉官法。

translations.literal: Thereupon all methods of recommendation by chief officials inside and outside [the capital] were entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon all methods of recommendation by chief officials inside and outside the capital were entirely abolished.

sentences.zh: 明年，令吏部始立定選格，其法：各隨所任職事，以入仕功狀，循格以俟擬注。

translations.literal: The next year, the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to establish fixed selection standards for the first time. The method: each according to the duties of the post held, on the basis of entry-to-office service merit records, follow the standards to await proposed assignment.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to establish fixed selection standards for the first time. Each category was to follow the duties of the post in question, using entry-to-office service records to meet the standards and await proposed assignment.

sentences.zh: 如選巡檢、捕盜官，則必因武舉、武學，或緣舉薦，或從獻策得出身之人。

translations.literal: For example, when selecting circuit patrollers and bandit-capture officials, they had to come from military examination graduates, military academy [graduates], or those who entered office through recommendation or through presenting strategy.
translations.idiomatic: When selecting circuit patrollers and bandit-capture officials, for example, candidates had to come from military examination or military academy graduates, or from those who had entered office through recommendation or by presenting strategy.

sentences.zh: 他皆仿此。

translations.literal: All other [categories] followed this model.
translations.idiomatic: All other categories followed this model.

sentences.zh: 自官制行，以舊少卿、監為朝議大夫，諸卿、監為中散大夫，秘書監為中大夫。

translations.literal: Since the office system took effect, former vice directors and commissioners were made Court Gentlemen for Discussion; [full] directors and commissioners Grand Masters of Palace Attendance; the Director of the Palace Library a Grand Master for Court Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Once the office system took effect, former vice directors and commissioners became Court Gentlemen for Discussion, full directors and commissioners became Grand Masters of Palace Attendance, and the Director of the Palace Library became a Grand Master for Court Assembly.

sentences.zh: 故事，兩製不轉卿、監官，每至前行郎中，即超轉諫議大夫。

translations.literal: By precedent, drafters of edicts did not transfer to director and commissioner posts; each time they reached front-rank bureau director, they were specially transferred to Grand Master of Remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent drafters of edicts did not transfer to director or commissioner posts; each time they reached front-rank bureau director they were specially promoted to Grand Master of Remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 前行郎中，於階官為朝請大夫；

translations.literal: Front-rank bureau director corresponded to the salary rank of Court Gentleman for Attending Court;
translations.idiomatic: Front-rank bureau director corresponded to the salary rank of Court Gentleman for Attending Court;

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫，於階官為太中大夫。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Remonstrance corresponded to the salary rank of Grand Master for Palace Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of Remonstrance corresponded to the salary rank of Grand Master for Palace Attendance.

sentences.zh: 帝謂：“磨勘者，古考績之法，所與百執事共之，而禁近獨超轉，非法也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Merit review is the ancient method of assessing performance, shared with all the hundred officials; yet those in palace proximity alone received special transfer -- this is unlawful.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Merit review is the ancient method of assessing performance, shared with all officials. Yet those in palace proximity alone received special promotion. That is unlawful.

sentences.zh: ”於是詔待制以下，並三年一遷，仍轉朝議、中散、中大夫三官。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict ordered that from Attendant Gentleman downward, all transferred once every three years, rotating through the three ranks of Court Gentleman for Discussion, Grand Master of Palace Attendance, and Grand Master for Court Assembly.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict then ordered that from Attendant Gentleman downward all officials would transfer once every three years, rotating through Court Gentleman for Discussion, Grand Master of Palace Attendance, and Grand Master for Court Assembly.

sentences.zh: 自是遷敘平允。

translations.literal: From this, transfers and seniority became fair and even.
translations.idiomatic: From this point transfers and seniority became fair and even.

sentences.zh: 凡開府儀同三司至通議大夫，無磨勘法；

translations.literal: For all from Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies to Grand Master for Consultation, there was no merit review law;
translations.idiomatic: From Grand Preceptor with honors equal to the Three Excellencies down to Grand Master for Consultation, there was no merit review law;

sentences.zh: 太中大夫至承務郎，皆應磨勘。

translations.literal: from Grand Master for Palace Attendance to Gentleman for Responsible Service, all were subject to merit review.
translations.idiomatic: from Grand Master for Palace Attendance to Gentleman for Responsible Service, all were subject to merit review.

sentences.zh: 待制以上六年遷兩官，至太中大夫止；

translations.literal: From Attendant Gentleman upward, transfer of two ranks every six years, stopping at Grand Master for Palace Attendance;
translations.idiomatic: From Attendant Gentleman upward, two ranks were transferred every six years, stopping at Grand Master for Palace Attendance;

sentences.zh: 承務郎以上四年遷一官，至朝請大夫止。

translations.literal: from Gentleman for Responsible Service upward, one rank every four years, stopping at Court Gentleman for Attending Court.
translations.idiomatic: from Gentleman for Responsible Service upward, one rank was transferred every four years, stopping at Court Gentleman for Attending Court.

sentences.zh: 朝議大夫以七十員為額，有闕，以次補之。

translations.literal: Court Gentleman for Discussion had a quota of seventy posts; when vacancies occurred, the next in order filled them.
translations.idiomatic: Court Gentleman for Discussion was capped at seventy posts; when vacancies occurred, the next in order filled them.

sentences.zh: 選人磨勘用吏部法，遷京朝官則依新定之製。

translations.literal: Candidates' merit review followed Ministry of Personnel law; promotion to capital official rank followed the newly fixed system.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates underwent merit review under Ministry of Personnel law; promotion to capital official rank followed the newly fixed system.

sentences.zh: 除授職事官，並以寄祿官品高下為法：凡高一品以上者為行，下一品者為守，二品以下者為試，品同者不用行、守、試。

translations.literal: When appointing substantive duty officials, all followed the higher or lower salary-rank grade: generally, one grade higher was acting, one grade lower was holding, two grades lower was trial, and equal grade did not use acting, holding, or trial.
translations.idiomatic: When appointing substantive duty officials, all followed the higher or lower salary-rank grade: one grade higher meant acting appointment, one grade lower meant holding appointment, two grades lower meant trial appointment, and equal grade required none of these.

sentences.zh: 哲宗時，御史上官均言：“今仕籍，合文武二萬八千餘員，吏部逆用兩任闕次，而仕者七年乃成一任。

translations.literal: During Emperor Zhezong's reign, Censor Shangguan Jun stated: "Today's service roster totals more than twenty-eight thousand civil and military officials. The Ministry of Personnel uses vacancy queues two terms in advance, yet an official needs seven years to complete one term.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Zhezong's reign, Censor Shangguan Jun reported, "Today's service roster totals more than twenty-eight thousand civil and military officials. The Ministry of Personnel draws on vacancy queues two terms in advance, yet an official needs seven years to complete one term.

sentences.zh: 當清其源，宜加裁抑。

translations.literal: The source should be cleared; restraint should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: The source should be cleared, and restraint should be increased.

sentences.zh: ”朝廷下其章議之，司諫蘇轍議曰：“祖宗舊法，凡任子，年及二十五方許出官，進士、諸科，初命及已任而應守選者，非逢恩不得放選。

translations.literal: " The court sent down his memorial for deliberation. Remonstrance Official Su Zhe argued: "Under the ancestral old law, all hereditary privilege appointees had to reach twenty-five before being permitted to take office; Presented Scholars and graduates of various categories, on first appointment or if already serving but required to wait for selection, could not be released for selection unless by grace edict.
translations.idiomatic: " The court sent down his memorial for deliberation. Remonstrance Official Su Zhe argued, "Under ancestral law, hereditary privilege appointees had to reach twenty-five before taking office. Presented Scholars and graduates of various categories, whether on first appointment or already serving but required to wait for selection, could not be released for selection except by grace edict.

sentences.zh: 先朝患官吏不習律令，欲誘之讀法，乃減任子出官年數，去守選之格，概令試法，通者隨得注官。

translations.literal: The previous court, troubled that officials did not study laws and regulations, wished to induce them to read the law; it reduced the age for hereditary privilege appointees to take office, removed the waiting-for-selection rule, and generally ordered a law examination; those who passed could immediately receive assignment.
translations.idiomatic: The previous court, troubled that officials did not study laws and regulations, sought to induce them to read the law. It reduced the age at which hereditary privilege appointees could take office, removed the waiting-for-selection rule, and generally ordered a law examination; those who passed could immediately receive assignment.

sentences.zh: 自是天下爭誦律令，於事不為無補。

translations.literal: From this the realm vied to recite laws and regulations, which was not without benefit to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: From this the realm vied to recite laws and regulations, which was not without benefit.

sentences.zh: 然人人習法，則試無不中，故蔭補者例減五年，而選人無復選限。

translations.literal: Yet when everyone studied the law, none failed the test; therefore yin-supplemented appointees routinely had five years reduced, and candidates no longer had selection waiting limits.
translations.idiomatic: Yet once everyone studied the law, none failed the test. Yin-supplemented appointees routinely had five years reduced, and candidates no longer faced selection waiting limits.

sentences.zh: 吏部員今年已用後四年夏秋闕，官冗至此亦極矣。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel this year has already consumed summer and autumn vacancies four years ahead; official redundancy has reached an extreme.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel this year has already consumed summer and autumn vacancies four years ahead. Official redundancy has reached an extreme.

sentences.zh: 宜追復祖宗守選舊法，而選滿之日，兼行試法之科，此亦今日之便也。

translations.literal: The ancestral waiting-for-selection old law should be restored, and when the selection wait is fulfilled, the law examination should also be administered -- this too would be convenient today.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestral waiting-for-selection law should be restored, and when the waiting period is fulfilled the law examination should also be administered. That too would serve the present need.

sentences.zh: ”事報聞。

translations.literal: " The matter was reported and noted.
translations.idiomatic: " The matter was reported and noted.

sentences.zh: 三省言：“舊經堂除選人，惟嚐曆省府推官、台諫、寺監長貳、郎官、監司外，悉付吏部銓注，凡格所應入，遞升一等以優之。

translations.literal: The Three Secretariats stated: "Candidates formerly appointed directly by the Secretariat had, except those who had served as provincial and metropolitan judicial administrators, censors and remonstrance officials, chief and vice directors of directorates and commissions, bureau directors, and supervisory officials, all been handed to the Ministry of Personnel for selection and assignment; whatever rank the standards entitled them to, they were advanced one grade as a preferential treatment.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Secretariats reported, "Candidates formerly appointed directly by the Secretariat, except those who had served as provincial and metropolitan judicial administrators, censorate and remonstrance officials, chief and vice directors of directorates and commissions, bureau directors, or supervisory officials, were all handed to the Ministry of Personnel for selection and assignment. Whatever rank the standards entitled them to, they were advanced one grade as a preferential treatment.

sentences.zh: 被邊州軍，其城砦巡檢、都監、監押、砦主、防巡、諸路捕盜官，及三萬緡以上課息場務，凡舊應舉官，員闕，許仍奏舉。

translations.literal: Border prefectures and commands: fort and stockade patrollers, superintending commissioners, supervisory commissioners, stockade chiefs, defensive patrol officers, bandit-capture officials on the various circuits, and revenue-producing transport posts with annual profits of thirty thousand strings and above -- for all posts formerly subject to memorial recommendation, when vacancies occurred, memorial recommendation was still permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In border prefectures and commands, fort and stockade patrollers, superintending commissioners, supervisory commissioners, stockade chiefs, defensive patrol officers, bandit-capture officials on the various circuits, and revenue-producing transport posts with annual profits of thirty thousand strings and above -- for all posts formerly subject to memorial recommendation, when vacancies occurred memorial recommendation was still permitted.

sentences.zh: ”時通議大夫以上，有以特恩、磨勘轉官，而比之舊格，或實轉兩官至三四官者。

translations.literal: " At the time, from Grand Master for Consultation upward, some received rank transfer through special grace or merit review, and compared with the old standards, some actually advanced two ranks to three or four.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time, from Grand Master for Consultation upward, some received rank transfer through special grace or merit review. Compared with the old standards, some actually advanced two ranks, or even three or four.

sentences.zh: 右正言王覿謂非所以愛惜名器，請官至太中大夫以上，毋用磨勘遷轉。

translations.literal: Right Rectifier Wang Di argued that this was not how to cherish titles of honor; he requested that from Grand Master for Palace Attendance upward, merit review transfer not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Right Rectifier Wang Di argued that this was no way to cherish titles of honor and requested that from Grand Master for Palace Attendance upward merit review transfer not be used.

sentences.zh: 詔：“待制、太中大夫應磨勘者，止於通議大夫，餘官止中散大夫。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Attendant Gentlemen and Grand Masters for Palace Attendance subject to merit review stop at Grand Master for Consultation; other offices stop at Grand Master of Palace Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "Attendant Gentlemen and Grand Masters for Palace Attendance subject to merit review stop at Grand Master for Consultation; other offices stop at Grand Master of Palace Attendance.

sentences.zh: 中散以上勞績酬獎，合進官者，止許回授子孫。

translations.literal: For Grand Master of Palace Attendance and above, meritorious service rewards entitling rank advancement were permitted only as transferred privilege to descendants.
translations.idiomatic: For Grand Master of Palace Attendance and above, meritorious service rewards entitling rank advancement were permitted only as transferred privilege to descendants.

sentences.zh: 特命特遷，不拘此製。

translations.literal: Special appointments and special transfers were not bound by this system.
translations.idiomatic: Special appointments and special transfers were not bound by this system.

sentences.zh: 初，武臣戰功得賞，凡一資，則從所居官遞遷一級。

translations.literal: Initially, when military officials received reward for battle merit, for each qualification credit they advanced one grade from their current post in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when military officials received reward for battle merit, each qualification credit advanced them one grade in succession from their current post.

sentences.zh: 於是以皇城使驟上遙刺，或入橫行；

translations.literal: Accordingly some Imperial City Commissioners suddenly rose to distant honorary prefectures, or entered the hengxing series;
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly some Imperial City Commissioners suddenly rose to distant honorary prefectures or entered the hengxing series;

sentences.zh: 且閣門使以上，等級相比而輕重絕遠。

translations.literal: moreover, from Gatehouse Commissioner upward, ranks appeared comparable yet their weight differed enormously.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, from Gatehouse Commissioner upward, ranks appeared comparable yet their weight differed enormously.

sentences.zh: 因樞密院言，乃詔“閣門、左藏庫副使得兩資，客省、皇城使得三資，止許一轉，減年者許回授親屬。

translations.literal: At the Bureau of Military Affairs' report, an edict stated: "Gatehouse and Left Storehouse deputy commissioners receive two qualification credits; Guest Reception and Imperial City commissioners receive three credits -- only one transfer is permitted; those with reduced years may transfer privilege to relatives.
translations.idiomatic: At the Bureau of Military Affairs' report, an edict stated, "Gatehouse and Left Storehouse deputy commissioners receive two qualification credits; Guest Reception and Imperial City commissioners receive three. Only one transfer is permitted; those with reduced years may transfer privilege to relatives.

sentences.zh: ”又小使臣磨勘轉崇班者，歲毋過八十人。

translations.literal: " For junior envoy-officials undergoing merit review and transfer to the exalted class, the year was not to exceed eighty persons.
translations.idiomatic: " For junior envoy-officials undergoing merit review and transfer to the exalted class, the annual quota was not to exceed eighty persons.

sentences.zh: 內臣昭宣使以上無磨勘法，惟押班以上則取裁，餘理五年磨勘。

translations.literal: Inner-service officials from Zhaoxuan Commissioner upward had no merit review law; only from Procession Marshal upward was discretion exercised; the rest followed five-year merit review.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-service officials from Zhaoxuan Commissioner upward had no merit review law; only from Procession Marshal upward was discretion exercised; the rest followed five-year merit review.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，改定《銓試格》，凡攝官初歸選，散官、權官歸司，若新賜第，皆免試。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaosheng, the Selection Examination Standards were revised. All provisional officials returning to candidacy for the first time, honorary-rank officials, acting officials returning to their bureau, and newly conferred degree holders were all exempt from examination.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shaosheng, the 《Selection Examination Standards》 were revised. Provisional officials returning to candidacy for the first time, honorary-rank officials, acting officials returning to their bureau, and newly conferred degree holders were all exempt from examination.

sentences.zh: 每試者百人，惟取一人入優等，中書奏裁，二人為上等，五人為中等。

translations.literal: For each hundred examinees, only one entered the superior grade, submitted to the Secretariat for decision; two were upper grade; five were middle grade.
translations.idiomatic: For each hundred examinees, only one entered the superior grade and was submitted to the Secretariat for decision; two were upper grade and five were middle grade.

sentences.zh: 崇寧以後，又復元豐製，而蔭補者須隸國學一年無過罰，乃試銓，若在學試嚐再入等，即免試；

translations.literal: After Chongning, the Yuanfeng system was restored, but yin-supplemented appointees had to enroll in the National University one year without punishment before taking the selection examination; if in school examinations they twice entered the grades, they were exempt;
translations.idiomatic: After Chongning the Yuanfeng system was restored, but yin-supplemented appointees had to enroll in the National University one year without punishment before taking the selection examination. If in school examinations they twice entered the grades, they were exempt;

sentences.zh: 其公、私試嚐居第一，得比銓試推恩。

translations.literal: those who once ranked first in public or private examinations received grace comparable to the selection examination.
translations.idiomatic: Those who once ranked first in public or private examinations received grace comparable to the selection examination.

sentences.zh: 政和間著為令。

translations.literal: In the Zhenghe era this was written into regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenghe era this was written into regulation.

sentences.zh: 既而臣僚言：“進士中銓格者，每二百人，得優恩不過五七人，又或闕上等不取。

translations.literal: Later officials stated: "Among Presented Scholars meeting selection standards, per two hundred persons, those receiving superior grace did not exceed five or seven, and sometimes upper grades were left unfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Later officials reported, "Among Presented Scholars meeting selection standards, out of every two hundred only five or seven received superior grace, and sometimes upper grades were left unfilled.

sentences.zh: 而朝廷取隸國子試格，用之銓注，及今五年，而得上等優恩者二百四十人，免試者尚在其外。

translations.literal: Yet the court took the standards for enrolled Imperial University examinations and applied them to selection and assignment; up to now for five years, those receiving upper or superior grace number two hundred forty, not counting those exempt from examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the court took the standards for enrolled Imperial University examinations and applied them to selection and assignment. Over five years those receiving upper or superior grace already number two hundred forty, not counting those exempt from examination.

sentences.zh: 是蔭補隸學者，優於累試得第之人矣。

translations.literal: Thus yin-supplemented students enrolled at school are favored over those who repeatedly tested and obtained degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Thus yin-supplemented students enrolled at school are favored over those who repeatedly tested and obtained degrees.

sentences.zh: ”於是詔在學嚐魁一試者，許如舊恩，餘止令免試注官。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict ordered that those who once ranked first in one school examination might receive the old grace; the rest were only exempt from examination for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict then ordered that those who once ranked first in one school examination might receive the old grace; the rest were only exempt from examination for assignment.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎彭汝礪乞稍責吏部甄別能否，凡京朝官才能事效苟有可錄，尚書暨郎官銓擇以聞。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Peng Ruli requested that the Ministry of Personnel be charged somewhat with distinguishing ability; for all capital officials whose talent and performance in office had anything worth recording, the ministry director and bureau directors were to select them and report.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Personnel Peng Ruli asked that the Ministry of Personnel be charged with distinguishing ability. For all capital officials whose talent and performance had anything worth recording, the ministry director and bureau directors were to select them and report.

sentences.zh: 三省分三年考察之，高則引對，次即試用，下者還之本選；

translations.literal: The Three Secretariats were to examine them over three years; the highest were presented in audience, the next were tried in office, the lowest returned to their original candidacy;
translations.idiomatic: The Three Secretariats were to examine them over three years; the highest were presented in audience, the next were tried in office, and the lowest returned to their original candidacy;

sentences.zh: 若資曆、舉薦應入高而才行不副，許奏而降其等。

translations.literal: if seniority and recommendations entitled them to higher entry but conduct and ability did not match, memorials were permitted to lower their grade.
translations.idiomatic: If seniority and recommendations entitled them to higher entry but conduct and ability did not match, memorials were permitted to lower their grade.

sentences.zh: 凡皆略許出法而加升黜，歲各毋過三人。

translations.literal: All were generally permitted departure from the law with added promotion or demotion, not exceeding three persons per year each.
translations.idiomatic: All were generally permitted departure from the law with added promotion or demotion, not exceeding three persons per year in each category.

sentences.zh: 初，選人改官，歲以百人為額。
