translations.literal: Initially, candidates changing office had an annual quota of one hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, candidates changing office had an annual quota of one hundred persons.

sentences.zh: 元祐變法，三人為甲，月三引見，積累至紹聖初，待次者二百八十餘人。

translations.literal: The Yuanyou reforms changed this to three persons per register group, three audiences per month; accumulated to the beginning of Shaosheng, those waiting numbered more than two hundred eighty.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanyou reforms changed this to three persons per register group and three audiences per month. By the beginning of Shaosheng those waiting numbered more than two hundred eighty.

sentences.zh: 詔依元豐五日而引一甲，甲以三人，歲毋過一百四十人，俟待次不及百人，別奏定。

translations.literal: An edict ordered return to the Yuanfeng rule of presenting one register group every five days, three per group, not exceeding one hundred forty per year; when those waiting fell below one hundred, a separate memorial would fix [the rule].
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered return to the Yuanfeng rule of presenting one register group every five days, three per group, not exceeding one hundred forty per year. When those waiting fell below one hundred, a separate memorial would fix the rule.

sentences.zh: 又令曆任通及三考，而資序已入幕職、令錄，方許舉之改官。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that after serving through three full appraisals in successive posts, and seniority having reached staff posts or magistrates and recorders, recommendation for office change was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: It was also ordered that after serving through three full appraisals in successive posts, and with seniority having reached staff posts or magistrates and recorders, recommendation for office change was permitted.

sentences.zh: 吏部言：“元豐選格，經元祐多所紛更，於是選集後先，路分遠近，資曆功過，悉無區別，逾等超資，惟其所欲。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel stated: "The Yuanfeng selection standards, after many Yuanyou alterations, left queue order in assemblies, distance of circuit route, seniority and merits or faults wholly undifferentiated; skipping grades and exceeding qualification was whatever one wished.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel reported, "The Yuanfeng selection standards, after many Yuanyou alterations, left queue order in assemblies, distance of circuit route, and seniority and merits or faults wholly undifferentiated. Skipping grades and exceeding qualification was whatever one wished.

sentences.zh: 詔旨既復元豐舊制，而辟舉一路尚存，請盡復舊法，以息僥幸。

translations.literal: The imperial intent having restored the Yuanfeng old system, yet the special recruitment route still remains; we ask to restore the old law entirely, to quiet opportunism.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial intent having restored the Yuanfeng old system, the special recruitment route still remains. We ask to restore the old law entirely to quiet opportunism.

sentences.zh: ”乃罷辟舉。

translations.literal: " Special recruitment was then abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " Special recruitment was then abolished.

sentences.zh: 初，未改官制，大率以職為階官。

translations.literal: Initially, before the office system was reformed, generally the duty post served as the salary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, before the office system was reformed, the duty post generally served as the salary rank.

sentences.zh: 如以吏部尚書為階官，而同中書門下平章事則其職也。

translations.literal: For example, Ministry of Personnel Director was the salary rank, while Concurrent Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery was the duty.
translations.idiomatic: For example, Ministry of Personnel Director was the salary rank, while Concurrent Grand Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery was the duty.

sentences.zh: 至於選人，則幕職、令錄之屬為階官，而以差遣為職，名實混淆甚矣。

translations.literal: As for candidates, staff posts and magistrates and recorders served as salary ranks, while temporary assignment was the duty -- name and substance were greatly confused.
translations.idiomatic: As for candidates, staff posts and magistrates and recorders served as salary ranks while temporary assignment was the duty. Name and substance were greatly confused.

sentences.zh: 元豐未及革正。

translations.literal: Yuanfeng did not in time reform this.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanfeng did not in time reform this.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年，刑部尚書鄧洵武極言之，遂定選人七階：曰承直郎，曰儒林郎，曰文林郎，曰從事郎，曰通仕郎，曰登仕郎，曰將仕郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongning, Minister of Punishments Deng Xunwu spoke forcefully on this; the seven candidate ranks were then fixed: Court Gentleman for Direct Achievement, Gentleman of the Forest of Scholars, Gentleman of the Forest of Letters, Gentleman for Attendant Service, Gentleman for Government Service, Gentleman for Entering Office, and Gentleman Preparing for Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongning, Minister of Punishments Deng Xunwu spoke forcefully on this, and the seven candidate ranks were fixed: Court Gentleman for Direct Achievement, Gentleman of the Forest of Scholars, Gentleman of the Forest of Letters, Gentleman for Attendant Service, Gentleman for Government Service, Gentleman for Entering Office, and Gentleman Preparing for Office.

sentences.zh: 政和間，改通仕為從政，登仕為修職，將仕為迪功，而專用通仕、登仕、將仕三階奏補未出官人，承直至修職須六考，迪功七考，有官保任而職司居其一，乃得磨勘。

translations.literal: In the Zhenghe era, Government Service was changed to Participation in Governance, Entering Office to Cultivation of Office, and Preparing for Office to Meritorious Achievement; the three lowest ranks alone were used for memorial supplementation of those not yet in office; from Direct Achievement through Cultivation of Office required six appraisals, Meritorious Achievement seven appraisals; with official guarantors of whom one held office in the responsible bureau, merit review was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenghe era Gentleman for Government Service was renamed Gentleman for Participation in Governance, Gentleman for Entering Office became Gentleman for Cultivation of Office, and Gentleman Preparing for Office became Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement. Only the three lowest ranks were used for memorial supplementation of those not yet in office. From Court Gentleman for Direct Achievement through Gentleman for Cultivation of Office required six appraisals and Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement seven. With official guarantors, one of whom held office in the responsible bureau, merit review was permitted.

sentences.zh: 坐愆犯，則隨輕重加考及舉官有差。

translations.literal: If guilty of offense, additional appraisals were added according to severity and recommending officials were penalized differentially.
translations.idiomatic: If guilty of offense, additional appraisals were added according to severity and recommending officials were penalized differentially.

sentences.zh: 時權奸柄國，僥幸並進，官員益濫，銓法留礙。

translations.literal: At the time a powerful faction held the state; opportunists advanced together; official ranks grew ever more redundant; and selection law was obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a powerful faction held the state. Opportunists advanced together, official ranks grew ever more redundant, and selection law was obstructed.

sentences.zh: 臣僚言：“吏員增多，蓋因入流日眾。

translations.literal: Officials stated: "The increase in officials stems from the daily growth of those entering the regular stream.
translations.idiomatic: Officials reported, "The increase in officials stems from the daily growth of those entering the regular stream.

sentences.zh: 熙寧郊禮，文武奏補總六百一十一員；

translations.literal: At the Xining suburban sacrifice, civil and military memorial supplementation totaled six hundred eleven posts;
translations.idiomatic: At the Xining suburban sacrifice, civil and military memorial supplementation totaled six hundred eleven posts;

sentences.zh: 元豐六年，選人磨勘改京朝官總一百三十有五員。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, candidates undergoing merit review and changing to capital official rank totaled one hundred thirty-five posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, candidates undergoing merit review and changing to capital official rank totaled one hundred thirty-five posts.

sentences.zh: 考之吏部，政和六年，郊恩奏補約一千四百六十有畸，選人改官約三百七十有畸。

translations.literal: Examining the Ministry of Personnel, in the sixth year of Zhenghe, suburban grace memorial supplementation was about one thousand four hundred sixty odd, and candidates changing office about three hundred seventy odd.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Ministry of Personnel, in the sixth year of Zhenghe suburban grace memorial supplementation was about one thousand four hundred sixty odd, and candidates changing office about three hundred seventy odd.

sentences.zh: 欲節其濫，惟嚴守磨勘舊法。

translations.literal: To restrain this redundancy, only strict adherence to the old merit review law [will suffice].
translations.idiomatic: To restrain this redundancy, only strict adherence to the old merit review law will suffice.

sentences.zh: 而今之磨勘，有局務減考第，有川遠減舉官，有用酬賞比類，有因大人特舉，有托事到闕不用滿任，有約法違礙許先次而改。

translations.literal: Yet today's merit review has reduced appraisals for transport-post duty, reduced recommenders for distant Sichuan posts, used reward precedents by analogy, relied on special recommendation by high officials, used arrival at court on business to avoid completing a full term, and permitted prior-order change when the law was violated.
translations.idiomatic: Yet today's merit review has reduced appraisals for transport-post duty, reduced recommenders for distant Sichuan posts, used reward precedents by analogy, relied on special recommendation by high officials, used arrival at court on business to avoid completing a full term, and permitted prior-order change when the law was violated.

sentences.zh: 凡皆棄法用例，法不能束而例日益繁，苟不裁之，將又倍蓰而未可計也。

translations.literal: All these abandon law and use precedent; law cannot bind while precedents daily grow more numerous; if not cut back, they will again multiply and become incalculable.
translations.idiomatic: All these abandon law and use precedent. Law cannot bind while precedents daily grow more numerous. If not cut back, they will multiply again beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 請詔三省若吏部，舊有止法，自當如故，餘皆毋得用例。

translations.literal: We ask that an edict order the Three Secretariats and the Ministry of Personnel: where old fixed law exists, it should remain as before; all else must not use precedent.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that an edict order the Three Secretariats and the Ministry of Personnel: where old fixed law exists, it should remain as before; all else must not use precedent.

sentences.zh: ”乃詔：“惟川、廣水土惡地，許減舉如製，餘悉用元豐法。

translations.literal: " An edict then stated: "Only for Sichuan and Guang regions with harsh terrain and water, reduced recommenders are permitted as regulated; all else wholly follows Yuanfeng law.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict then stated, "Only for Sichuan and Guang regions with harsh terrain and water are reduced recommenders permitted as regulated; all else wholly follows Yuanfeng law.

sentences.zh: ”既而又言：“元豐進納官法，多所裁抑。

translations.literal: " Later they again stated: "The Yuanfeng purchase-of-office law imposed many restraints.
translations.idiomatic: " Later they again reported, "The Yuanfeng purchase-of-office law imposed many restraints.

sentences.zh: 應入令錄及因賞得職官，止與監當，該磨勘者換授降等使臣，仍不免科率，法意深矣。

translations.literal: Those entitled to magistrates and recorders and those receiving substantive posts through reward were given only supervisory duty; those subject to merit review received exchanged appointment as reduced-grade envoy-officials and still could not escape tax levies -- the intent of the law was profound.
translations.idiomatic: Those entitled to magistrates and recorders and those receiving substantive posts through reward were given only supervisory duty. Those subject to merit review received exchanged appointment as reduced-grade envoy-officials and still could not escape tax levies. The intent of the law was profound.

sentences.zh: 邇者用兵東南，民入金穀皆得補文武官，理選如官戶，與士大夫涇、渭並流，復其戶不受科輸。

translations.literal: Recently in the southeastern campaign, commoners who contributed gold and grain could all be supplemented as civil or military officials, processed for selection like official households, intermingled with scholar-officials like the Jing and Wei rivers, and had their households restored and exempted from tax transport.
translations.idiomatic: Recently in the southeastern campaign, commoners who contributed gold and grain could all be supplemented as civil or military officials, processed for selection like official households, and intermingled with scholar-officials like the Jing and Wei rivers. Their households were restored and exempted from tax transport.

sentences.zh: 是得數千緡於一日，而失數萬斛於無窮也。

translations.literal: This gains several thousand strings in one day but loses tens of thousands of hu forever.
translations.idiomatic: This gains several thousand strings in one day but loses tens of thousands of hu forever.

sentences.zh: 況大戶得復，則移其科於下戶，下戶重貧，州縣緩急，責辦何人？

translations.literal: Moreover, when great households are restored, their tax burden shifts to lesser households; lesser households are heavily impoverished -- in prefecture and county emergencies, upon whom will responsibility fall?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when great households are restored, their tax burden shifts to lesser households. Lesser households are heavily impoverished. In prefecture and county emergencies, upon whom will responsibility fall?

sentences.zh: 此又弊之大者。

translations.literal: This too is among the greatest abuses.
translations.idiomatic: This too is among the greatest abuses.

sentences.zh: ”不聽。

translations.literal: " [The court] did not heed [this].
translations.idiomatic: " The court did not heed this.

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎初，行都置吏部。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyan under Emperor Gaozong, the Ministry of Personnel was established at the mobile capital.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianyan under Emperor Gaozong, the Ministry of Personnel was established at the mobile capital.

sentences.zh: 時四選散亡，名籍莫考。

translations.literal: At the time the four selection streams were scattered and lost; name registers could not be verified.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the four selection streams were scattered and lost, and name registers could not be verified.

sentences.zh: 始下諸道州、府、軍、監，條具屬吏寓官之爵裏、年甲、出身、曆仕功過、舉主、到罷月日，編而籍之。

translations.literal: An order was first sent to prefectures, commands, and supervisory posts on the various circuits to itemize subordinate officials and stationed officials' titles, residences, age, entry to office, successive service merits and faults, recommenders, and arrival and departure dates, compile them, and register them.
translations.idiomatic: An order was first sent to prefectures, commands, and supervisory posts on the various circuits to itemize subordinate officials and stationed officials' titles, residences, age, entry to office, successive service merits and faults, recommenders, and arrival and departure dates, compile them, and register them.

sentences.zh: 然自兵難以來，典籍散失，吏緣為私，申明繁苛，承用踳駮，保任滋眾，阻會無期，參選者苦之。

translations.literal: Yet since the military crisis, records had been scattered and lost; clerks exploited this for private gain; clarifications were numerous and harsh; application was confused and contradictory; guarantors multiplied; blocking assemblies had no fixed term; and those assembling for selection suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Yet since the military crisis records had been scattered and lost. Clerks exploited this for private gain, clarifications were numerous and harsh, application was confused and contradictory, guarantors multiplied, blocking assemblies had no fixed term, and those assembling for selection suffered.

sentences.zh: 乃令凡文字有不應於今，而桉牘參照明白，從郎官審覆，長貳予決，小不完者聽行，有狥私挾情，則令御史糾之。

translations.literal: It was then ordered that for all documents not conforming to present rules, if case files and references were clear, bureau directors were to review and chief and vice directors decide; minor incompleteness was permitted to proceed; if there was favoritism or personal motive, censors were ordered to impeach.
translations.idiomatic: It was then ordered that for all documents not conforming to present rules, if case files and references were clear, bureau directors were to review and chief and vice directors decide. Minor incompleteness was permitted to proceed; if there was favoritism or personal motive, censors were ordered to impeach.

sentences.zh: 又詔京畿、京東、河北、京西、河東士夫在部注授，雖銓未中而年及者，皆聽注官。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered that scholar-officials of the capital region, eastern capital circuit, Hebei, western capital circuit, and Hedong who were at the ministry for assignment, even if they had not passed selection but their age qualified, were all permitted assignment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered that scholar-officials of the capital region, eastern capital circuit, Hebei, western capital circuit, and Hedong who were at the ministry for assignment, even if they had not passed selection but their age qualified, were all permitted assignment.

sentences.zh: 二年，命京官赴行在者，令吏部審量，非政和以後進書頌及直赴殿試之人，乃聽參選。

translations.literal: In the second year, capital officials proceeding to the mobile court were ordered examined by the Ministry of Personnel; only those who were not persons who after Zhenghe submitted books of praise or went directly to the palace examination were permitted to assemble for selection.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, capital officials proceeding to the mobile court were ordered examined by the Ministry of Personnel. Only those who had not, after Zhenghe, submitted books of praise or gone directly to the palace examination were permitted to assemble for selection.

sentences.zh: 在部知州軍、通判、僉判及京朝官知縣、監當以三年為任者，權改為二年。

translations.literal: For prefects and commanders, transit intendants, assistant judicial administrators at the ministry, and capital officials serving as county magistrates or supervisory duty on three-year terms, the term was provisionally changed to two years.
translations.idiomatic: For prefects and commanders, transit intendants, assistant judicial administrators at the ministry, and capital officials serving as county magistrates or supervisory duty on three-year terms, the term was provisionally changed to two years.

sentences.zh: 以赴調者萃東南，選法留滯故也。

translations.literal: This was because those proceeding to audience assembled in the southeast, and selection law was delayed.
translations.idiomatic: This was because those proceeding to audience assembled in the southeast and selection law was delayed.

sentences.zh: 又詔州縣久無正官者，聽在選人申部，審度榜闕差注。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered that where prefectures and counties long lacked regular officials, candidates at the ministry were permitted to apply; vacancies would be posted after review for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered that where prefectures and counties long lacked regular officials, candidates at the ministry were permitted to apply, and vacancies would be posted after review for assignment.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，起居郎胡寅言：“今典章文物，廢墜無幾，百司庶府不可闕者，莫如吏部。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing, Attending Gentleman Hu Yin stated: "Today institutions and cultural artifacts have fallen into ruin with little remaining; among the hundred offices and various bureaus that cannot be lacking, none compares to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing, Attending Gentleman Hu Yin reported, "Today institutions and cultural artifacts have fallen into ruin with little remaining. Among the hundred offices and various bureaus that cannot be lacking, none compares to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 姑置侍郎一員，郎官二員，胥吏三十人，則所謂磨勘、封敘、奏薦常程之事，可按而舉矣。

translations.literal: For the moment appoint one vice minister, two bureau directors, and thirty clerks, and then the so-called routine matters of merit review, enfeoffment and posthumous honors, and memorial recommendation can be carried out in order.
translations.idiomatic: For the moment appoint one vice minister, two bureau directors, and thirty clerks, and then the routine matters of merit review, enfeoffment and posthumous honors, and memorial recommendation can be carried out in order.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：“六官之長，佐王理邦國者，其惟銓衡乎。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Of the chiefs of the six ministries who assist the king in governing the realm, is not selection and weighing the foremost?
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated, "Of the chiefs of the six ministries who assist the king in governing the realm, is not selection and weighing the foremost?

sentences.zh: 亂離以來，士大夫流徙，有徒跣而赴行在者。

translations.literal: Since the chaos and dispersal, scholar-officials have wandered in exile; some have gone barefoot to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: Since the chaos and dispersal, scholar-officials have wandered in exile. Some have gone barefoot to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 注授榜闕，奸弊日滋，寒士困苦，甚可憫焉。

translations.literal: Assignment postings of vacancies [are plagued by corruption]; corrupt practices daily increase; poor scholars suffer hardship -- it is deeply lamentable.
translations.idiomatic: Corruption in posting vacancies for assignment grows daily, and poor scholars suffer greatly -- a matter deeply to be lamented.

sentences.zh: 宜令三省議除其弊，嚴立賞禁，仍選能吏以主之，御史台常加糾察。

translations.literal: It is fitting to order the Three Secretariats to discuss removing these abuses, strictly establish rewards and prohibitions, moreover select capable clerks to preside, and have the Censorate regularly add scrutiny and investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Secretariats should be ordered to discuss removing these abuses, strictly establish rewards and prohibitions, select capable clerks to oversee the work, and have the Censorate conduct regular scrutiny.

sentences.zh: ”於是三省立八事，曰注擬藏闕，申請徼幸，去失問難，刷闕滅裂，關會淹延，審量疑似，給付邀求，保明退難。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the Three Secretariats established eight matters, called hoarding vacancies in proposed assignments, opportunistic applications, questioning over lost documents, tearing up vacancy lists, delaying joint consultations, ambiguous review of doubtful cases, demanding payment for disbursement, and guarantors backing away from difficulties.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon the Three Secretariats established eight categories of abuse: hoarding vacancies in proposed assignments, opportunistic applications, questioning over lost documents, tearing up vacancy lists, delaying joint consultations, ambiguous review of doubtful cases, demanding payment for disbursement, and guarantors backing away from difficulties.

sentences.zh: 令長貳機柅之。

translations.literal: [They] ordered chief and vice directors to restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: Chief and vice directors were ordered to restrain them.

sentences.zh: 又詔館職選人到任及一年，通理四考，並自陳，改京官。

translations.literal: An edict also [ordered that] academy-post candidates who had served one year upon taking office, having completed four merit evaluations in total, were all to self-petition for change to capital official rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered that academy-post candidates who had served one year upon taking office and completed four merit evaluations in total were all to self-petition for promotion to capital official rank.

sentences.zh: 二年，呂頤浩言：“近世堂除，多侵部注，士人失職。

translations.literal: In the second year, Lü Yihao said: "In recent times direct Secretariat appointments often encroach on Ministry assignments, and scholar-officials lose their proper posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Lü Yihao said, "In recent times direct Secretariat appointments often encroach on Ministry assignments, and scholar-officials lose their proper posts.

sentences.zh: 宜仿祖宗故事，外自監司、郡守及舊格堂除通判，內自察官省郎以上、館職、書局編修官外，餘闕並寺監丞、法寺官、六院等，武臣自準備將領、正副將以上，其部將、巡尉、指使以下，並歸部注。

translations.literal: It is fitting to follow the precedents of the dynastic founders. Externally, from circuit supervisors and prefects and transit intendants directly appointed under old standards downward; internally, from censorate and ministry bureau directors upward, academy posts, and Secretariat Chancellery compilation editors excepted; all remaining vacancies including directorate and commission deputies, judiciary posts, the Six Bureaus, and the like; for military officials from reserve commanders and regular and deputy commanders upward; company commanders, patrol prefects, directors, and below shall all revert to Ministry assignment.
translations.idiomatic: We should follow the precedents of the dynastic founders. Externally, from circuit supervisors and prefects downward, and transit intendants under the old standards for direct appointment; internally, from censorate and ministry bureau directors upward, academy posts, and Secretariat Chancellery compilation editors excepted; all remaining vacancies including directorate and commission deputies, judiciary posts, the Six Bureaus, and the like; for military officials from reserve commanders and regular and deputy commanders upward; company commanders, patrol prefects, directors, and below should all revert to Ministry assignment.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: " The court assented.

sentences.zh: 又復文臣銓試，以經義、詩賦、時議、斷案、律義為五場，願試一場者聽，榜首循一資。

translations.literal: The civil officials' selection examination was restored, with classical interpretation, regulated verse, current policy essay, case judgment, and statutory interpretation as five sessions; those wishing to test in only one session were permitted; the top candidate advanced one seniority grade.
translations.idiomatic: The civil officials' selection examination was restored, with classical interpretation, regulated verse, current policy essay, case judgment, and statutory interpretation as five sessions. Those wishing to test in only one session were permitted, and the top candidate advanced one seniority grade.

sentences.zh: 武臣呈試合格者並聽參選。

translations.literal: Military officials who passed the presentation examination were all permitted to assemble for selection.
translations.idiomatic: Military officials who passed the presentation examination were all permitted to assemble for selection.

sentences.zh: 三年，右仆射朱勝非等上《吏部七司敕令格式》。

translations.literal: In the third year, Right Vice Director Zhu Shengfei and others submitted the 《Statutes, Commands, and Formats of the Ministry of Personnel's Seven Bureaus》.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Right Vice Director Zhu Shengfei and others submitted the 《Statutes, Commands, and Formats of the Ministry of Personnel's Seven Bureaus》.

sentences.zh: 自渡江後，文籍散佚，會廣東轉運司以所錄元豐、元祐吏部法來上，乃以省記舊法及續降指揮，詳定而成此書。

translations.literal: Since crossing the river, documents had been scattered and lost; it happened that the Guangdong Transport Commission submitted its records of Yuanfeng and Yuanyou Ministry of Personnel laws; [the ministry] then used archived old laws and subsequently issued directives, reviewed and fixed them, and completed this book.
translations.idiomatic: Since crossing the river, documents had been scattered and lost. The Guangdong Transport Commission happened to submit its records of Yuanfeng and Yuanyou Ministry of Personnel laws, and the ministry then used archived old laws and subsequently issued directives, reviewed and fixed them, and completed this book.

sentences.zh: 先是，侍御史沈與求言：“今日矯枉太過，賢愚同滯。

translations.literal: Previously, Supervising Censor Shen Yuqiu had said: "Today in over-correcting we have gone too far; the worthy and the foolish alike are stalled.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, Supervising Censor Shen Yuqiu had said, "Today in over-correcting we have gone too far; the worthy and the foolish alike are stalled.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“果有豪傑之士，雖自布衣擢為輔相可也；

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "If there is truly a heroic talent, even promotion from commoner status to chief counselor would be acceptable;
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "If there is truly a heroic talent, even promotion from commoner status to chief counselor would be acceptable;

sentences.zh: 苟未能考其實，不若姑守資格。

translations.literal: if we cannot verify substance, it is better for the moment to observe seniority standards.
translations.idiomatic: if we cannot verify substance, it is better for the moment to observe seniority standards.

sentences.zh: ”乃命吏部注授縣令，惟用合格之人。

translations.literal: " The Ministry of Personnel was ordered to assign county magistrates using only qualified persons.
translations.idiomatic: " The Ministry of Personnel was ordered to assign county magistrates using only qualified persons.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔：“凡注擬，並選擇非老疾及未嚐犯贓與非緣民事被罪之人。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "For all proposed assignments, only select persons who are not aged or ill, who have not previously committed corruption offenses, and who have not been punished for civil-administration matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an edict stated, "For all proposed assignments, only select persons who are not aged or ill, who have not previously committed corruption offenses, and who have not been punished for civil-administration matters.

sentences.zh: ”時建議者云：“親民莫如縣令，今率限以資格，雖貪懦之人，一或應格，則大官大邑得以自擇。

translations.literal: " At the time a proponent said: "No one governs the people like the county magistrate; now we generally limit by seniority standards -- even greedy and timid men, once they meet the standards, can choose among large posts and large counties for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: " At the time a proponent said, "No one governs the people like the county magistrate. Now we generally limit by seniority standards -- even greedy and timid men, once they meet the standards, can choose among large posts and large counties for themselves.

sentences.zh: 請詔監司、郡守，條上劇邑，遴選清平廉察之人為之。

translations.literal: We request an edict to circuit supervisors and prefects to itemize and submit demanding counties and carefully select persons of integrity, fairness, and sharp judgment for them.
translations.idiomatic: We request an edict to circuit supervisors and prefects to itemize and submit demanding counties and carefully select persons of integrity, fairness, and sharp judgment for them.

sentences.zh: ”既而又詔：“知縣依舊法，止用兩任關升通判資序。

translations.literal: " Then another edict stated: "County magistrates, according to the old law, require only the seniority grade of two terms' sequential promotion to transit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: " Then another edict stated, "County magistrates, according to the old law, require only the seniority grade of two terms' sequential promotion to transit intendant.

sentences.zh: ”明年，侍御史周祕言：“今有無舉員考第，因近臣薦對，即改官升擢，實長奔競。

translations.literal: " The next year, Supervising Censor Zhou Mi said: "Today there are those with no examination standing or rank placement who, through recommendation and audience by close court officials, immediately receive office change and promotion -- this truly encourages unscrupulous competition.
translations.idiomatic: " The next year, Supervising Censor Zhou Mi said, "Today there are those with no examination standing or rank placement who, through recommendation and audience by close court officials, immediately receive office change and promotion -- this truly encourages unscrupulous competition.

sentences.zh: 望詔大臣，自今惟賢德才能之人，餘並依格注擬。

translations.literal: We hope the Emperor will edict the great ministers that from now on only persons of virtue, talent, and ability [receive such favor], and all others shall be assigned according to standards.
translations.idiomatic: We hope the Emperor will edict the great ministers that from now on only persons of virtue, talent, and ability should receive such favor, and all others shall be assigned according to standards.

sentences.zh: ”廷臣或請以前宰執所舉改官，易以司馬光十科之目，歲薦五員，中書難之。

translations.literal: " Some court officials requested replacing office change through recommendations by former chief counselors with Sima Guang's ten categories, recommending five persons per year; the Secretariat Chancellery objected.
translations.idiomatic: " Some court officials requested replacing office change through recommendations by former chief counselors with Sima Guang's ten categories, recommending five persons per year, but the Secretariat Chancellery objected.

sentences.zh: 詔“前宰執所舉京削，不理職司”而已。

translations.literal: An edict [said] only that "recommendations by former chief counselors for capital rank conferral shall not count toward supervisory posts."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said only that "recommendations by former chief counselors for capital rank conferral shall not count toward supervisory posts."

sentences.zh: 三十二年，吏部侍郎淩景夏言：“國家設銓選以聽群吏之治，其掌於七司，著在令甲，所守者法也。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, Vice Minister of Personnel Ling Jingxia said: "The state established selection to govern the administration of the multitude of officials; it is managed in seven bureaus, recorded in statutory commands, and what is observed is law.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, Vice Minister of Personnel Ling Jingxia said, "The state established selection to govern the administration of the multitude of officials. It is managed in seven bureaus, recorded in statutory commands, and what is observed is law.

sentences.zh: 今升降於胥吏之手，有所謂例焉。

translations.literal: Today promotions and demotions lie in the hands of clerks; there is what is called precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Today promotions and demotions lie in the hands of clerks; there is what is called precedent.

sentences.zh: 長貳有遷改，郎曹有替移，來者不可復知，去者不能盡告。

translations.literal: Chief and vice directors are transferred, bureau sections have replacements; newcomers cannot again know [the precedents], and those departing cannot fully inform [their successors].
translations.idiomatic: Chief and vice directors are transferred and bureau sections have replacements. Newcomers cannot again know the precedents, and those departing cannot fully inform their successors.

sentences.zh: 索例而不獲，雖有強明健敏之才，不復致議；

translations.literal: When seeking precedent and not obtaining it, even if one has forceful clarity and vigorous sensitivity, one no longer enters into deliberation;
translations.idiomatic: When seeking precedent and not obtaining it, even if one has forceful clarity and vigorous sensitivity, one no longer enters into deliberation;

sentences.zh: 引例而不當，雖有至公盡理之事，不復可伸。

translations.literal: when citing precedent that is inappropriate, even if there is a matter of utmost fairness and complete reason, it can no longer be upheld.
translations.idiomatic: when citing precedent that is inappropriate, even if there is a matter of utmost fairness and complete reason, it can no longer be upheld.

sentences.zh: 貨賄公行，奸弊滋甚。

translations.literal: Bribes proceed openly; corrupt practices grow worse daily.
translations.idiomatic: Bribes proceed openly and corrupt practices grow worse daily.

sentences.zh: 嚐睹漢之公府有辭訟比，尚書有決事比，比之為言，猶今之例。

translations.literal: I have seen that in Han the public offices had litigation precedents and the Ministry had decision precedents; the word bi means what today we call precedent.
translations.idiomatic: I have seen that in Han the public offices had litigation precedents and the Ministry had decision precedents; the word bi means what today we call precedent.

sentences.zh: 今吏部七司宜置例冊，凡換給之期限，戰功之定處，去失之保任，書填之審實，奏薦之限隔，酬賞之用否，凡經申請，或堂白、或取旨者，每一事已，命郎官以次擬定，而長貳書之於冊，永以為例，每半歲上於尚書省，仍關御史台。

translations.literal: Now the Ministry's seven bureaus ought to establish precedent volumes. For all deadlines on replacement credentials, fixed locations of military merit, guarantor responsibility for lost documents, verification of written forms, intervals for memorial recommendations, and whether rewards apply -- for all matters that pass through application, whether decided by hall consultation or by obtaining imperial intent -- once each matter is completed, bureau directors are to draft the decision in sequence, and chief and vice directors record it in the volume as permanent precedent; every half year it is submitted to the Department of State Affairs, and the Censorate is also notified.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Ministry's seven bureaus ought to establish precedent volumes. For all deadlines on replacement credentials, fixed locations of military merit, guarantor responsibility for lost documents, verification of written forms, intervals for memorial recommendations, and whether rewards apply -- for all matters that pass through application, whether decided by hall consultation or by obtaining imperial intent -- once each matter is completed, bureau directors should draft the decision in sequence and chief and vice directors record it in the volume as permanent precedent. Every half year it is submitted to the Department of State Affairs, and the Censorate is also notified.

sentences.zh: 如是，則巧吏無所施，而銓敘平允矣。

translations.literal: If so, clever clerks have nowhere to apply their tricks, and selection and seniority ranking will be fair.
translations.idiomatic: If so, clever clerks have nowhere to apply their tricks, and selection and seniority ranking will be fair.

sentences.zh: 有議減任子者，孝宗以祖宗法令難於遽改，令吏部嚴選試之法。

translations.literal: There was discussion of reducing yin privilege for sons; Emperor Xiaozong held that dynastic founding laws were difficult to change abruptly and ordered the Ministry to tighten selection examination regulations.
translations.idiomatic: There was discussion of reducing yin privilege for sons. Emperor Xiaozong held that dynastic founding laws were difficult to change abruptly and ordered the Ministry to tighten selection examination regulations.

sentences.zh: 自是，初官毋以恩例免試，雖宰執亦不許自陳回授。

translations.literal: From this time, first office could not use grace precedent to skip examination; even chief counselors were not permitted self-petition for transferred appointment.
translations.idiomatic: From this time, first office could not use grace precedent to skip examination; even chief counselors were not permitted self-petition for transferred appointment.

sentences.zh: 舊制，任子降等補文學及恩科人皆免，至是悉試焉。

translations.literal: Under the old system, sons receiving yin privilege who received reduced-rank literary supplementation and persons of grace examination category were all exempt; from this time all were examined.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, sons receiving yin privilege who received reduced-rank literary supplementation and persons of grace examination category were all exempt; from this time all were examined.

sentences.zh: 凡未經銓中及呈試者，勿堂除；

translations.literal: All who had not passed selection examination or presentation examination were not to receive direct Secretariat appointment;
translations.idiomatic: All who had not passed selection examination or presentation examination were not to receive direct Secretariat appointment;

sentences.zh: 雖墨敕，亦許執奏。

translations.literal: even with sealed edicts, holding up and memorializing [objection] was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: even with sealed edicts, holding up and memorializing objection was permitted.

sentences.zh: 舊制，宗室文資與外官文臣參注窠闕，武資則不得與武臣參注，但注添差。

translations.literal: Under the old system, clansmen with civil credentials competed with outside civil officials for regular vacancies; those with military credentials could not compete with military officials for assignment but received only supplementary appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, clansmen with civil credentials competed with outside civil officials for regular vacancies, while those with military credentials could not compete with military officials for assignment and received only supplementary appointments.

sentences.zh: 至是，始聽注厘務闕。

translations.literal: From this time, they were first permitted assignment to revenue and supplies posts.
translations.idiomatic: From this time, they were first permitted assignment to revenue and supplies posts.

sentences.zh: 七年，始命銓試不中、年四十，呈試不中、年三十者，令寫家狀，讀律注官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, it was first ordered that those who failed selection examination at age forty and those who failed presentation examination at age thirty were to submit household registers and, after reading law, receive office assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, it was first ordered that those who failed selection examination at age forty and those who failed presentation examination at age thirty were to submit household registers and, after reading law, receive office assignment.

sentences.zh: 陳師正言：“請令宗室恩任子弟出官日量行銓試，如士夫子弟之法，多立其額而優為之製。

translations.literal: Chen Shizheng said: "We request that when clansmen's sons receiving grace appointment take first office, they undergo selection examination in measured fashion, like common scholar-officials' sons -- increase the quota and make the system preferential.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shizheng said, "We request that when clansmen's sons receiving grace appointment take first office, they undergo selection examination in measured fashion, like common scholar-officials' sons -- increase the quota and make the system preferential.

sentences.zh: ”遂詔：“自今宗室曾經應舉得解者，許參選，餘並行銓試，三人取二。

translations.literal: " An edict then stated: "From now on clansmen who have taken the examinations and received preliminary qualification are permitted to assemble for selection; all others shall take the selection examination, with two of three passing.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict then stated, "From now on clansmen who have taken the examinations and received preliminary qualification are permitted to assemble for selection. All others shall take the selection examination, with two of three passing.

sentences.zh: 其三試終場不中人，聽不拘年限調官。

translations.literal: Those who after three full examination attempts still failed were permitted office assignment without regard to waiting limits.
translations.idiomatic: Those who after three full examination attempts still failed were permitted office assignment without regard to waiting limits.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，參知政事龔茂良言：“官人之道，在朝廷則當量人才，在銓部則宜守成法。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi, Vice Grand Counselor Gong Maoliang said: "The way of appointing officials: at court one should measure talent; at the selection ministry one should observe established law.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chunxi, Vice Grand Counselor Gong Maoliang said, "The way of appointing officials: at court one should measure talent; at the selection ministry one should observe established law.

sentences.zh: 法本無弊，例實敗之。

translations.literal: Law in itself has no flaw; precedent is what ruins it.
translations.idiomatic: Law in itself has no flaw; precedent is what ruins it.

sentences.zh: 法者，公天下而為之者也；

translations.literal: Law is made for the public good of all under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: Law is made for the public good of all under Heaven;

sentences.zh: 例者，因人而立以壞天下之公者也。

translations.literal: precedent is established for individuals and destroys the public good of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: precedent is established for individuals and destroys the public good of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 昔之患在於用例破法，今之患在於因例立法。

translations.literal: The former trouble lay in using precedent to break law; today's trouble lies in legislating through precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The former trouble lay in using precedent to break law; today's trouble lies in legislating through precedent.

sentences.zh: 諺稱吏部為‘例部’。

translations.literal: Proverb calls the Ministry of Personnel the 'Ministry of Precedent.'
translations.idiomatic: Proverb calls the Ministry of Personnel the 'Ministry of Precedent.'

sentences.zh: 今《七司法》自晏敦復裁定，不無疏略，然守之亦可以無弊。

translations.literal: Now the 《Seven Bureaus Law》 since Yan Dunfu's revision is not without omissions, yet observing it can still avoid abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Now the 《Seven Bureaus Law》, since Yan Dunfu's revision, is not without omissions, yet observing it can still avoid abuses.

sentences.zh: 而徇情廢法，相師成風，蓋用例破法其害小，因例立法其害大。

translations.literal: Yet indulging personal favor and abandoning law, one teaching another until it becomes custom -- using precedent to break law harms little; legislating through precedent harms much.
translations.idiomatic: Yet indulging personal favor and abandoning law, one teaching another until it becomes custom -- using precedent to break law harms little, but legislating through precedent harms much.

sentences.zh: 法常靳，例常寬，今法令繁多，官曹冗濫，蓋繇此也。

translations.literal: Law is always strict, precedent always lenient; today laws and commands are numerous and offices redundant -- largely from this.
translations.idiomatic: Law is always strict and precedent always lenient. Today laws and commands are numerous and offices redundant -- largely from this.

sentences.zh: 望令裒集參附法及乾道續降申明，重行考定，非大有牴牾者弗去，凡涉寬縱者悉刊正之。

translations.literal: We hope to order gathering the supplementary statutes and Qianlong-era subsequently issued clarifications, conduct renewed review and fixing, remove nothing unless greatly contradictory, and correct all involving undue leniency.
translations.idiomatic: We hope to order gathering the supplementary statutes and Qianlong-era subsequently issued clarifications, conduct renewed review and fixing, remove nothing unless greatly contradictory, and correct all involving undue leniency.

sentences.zh: 庶幾國家成法，簡易明白，賕謝之奸絕，冒濫之門塞矣。

translations.literal: Thus perhaps the state's established law will be simple and clear, bribery's wickedness ended, and the gate of reckless advancement blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Thus perhaps the state's established law will be simple and clear, bribery's wickedness ended, and the gate of reckless advancement blocked.

sentences.zh: ”於是重修焉。

translations.literal: " Thereupon it was revised.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon it was revised.

sentences.zh: 既而吏部尚書蔡洸以改官、奏薦、磨勘、差注等條法分門編類，名《吏部條法總類》。

translations.literal: Subsequently Minister Cai Guang classified regulations on office change, memorial recommendation, merit review, and assignment by category, naming it 《General Collection of Ministry of Personnel Statutes》.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently Minister Cai Guang classified regulations on office change, memorial recommendation, merit review, and assignment by category, naming it 《General Collection of Ministry of Personnel Statutes》.

sentences.zh: 十一月，《七司敕令格式申明》成書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the 《Clarifications to the Seven Bureaus' Statutes, Commands, and Formats》 was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the 《Clarifications to the Seven Bureaus' Statutes, Commands, and Formats》 was completed.

sentences.zh: 淳熙三年，中書舍人程大昌言：“舊制，選人改秩後兩任關升通判，通判兩任關升知州，知州兩任即理提刑資序。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunxi, Drafter Cheng Dachang said: "Under the old system, after candidates changed rank, two terms' sequential promotion reached transit intendant; two terms as transit intendant reached prefect; two terms as prefect then counted toward judicial commissioner seniority.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chunxi, Drafter Cheng Dachang said, "Under the old system, after candidates changed rank, two terms' sequential promotion reached transit intendant; two terms as transit intendant reached prefect; two terms as prefect then counted toward judicial commissioner seniority.

sentences.zh: 除授之際，則又有別以知縣資序隔兩等而作州者，謂之‘權發遣’，以通判資序隔一等而作州者，謂之‘權知’，上而提刑、轉運亦然。

translations.literal: At time of appointment and conferral, there were also separate cases: using county magistrate seniority two ranks lower to serve as prefect was called 'acting dispatched'; using transit intendant seniority one rank lower to serve as prefect was called 'acting prefect'; upward, judicial commissioner and transport commissioner were similar.
translations.idiomatic: At time of appointment and conferral, there were also separate cases: using county magistrate seniority two ranks lower to serve as prefect was called 'acting dispatched'; using transit intendant seniority one rank lower to serve as prefect was called 'acting prefect'; upward, judicial commissioner and transport commissioner followed the same pattern.

sentences.zh: 隔等而授，是擇材能也；

translations.literal: Appointment across ranks was selecting talent and ability;
translations.idiomatic: Appointment across ranks was selecting talent and ability;

sentences.zh: 結銜有差，是參用資格也。

translations.literal: differences in formal title reflected combined use of seniority standards.
translations.idiomatic: differences in formal title reflected combined use of seniority standards.

sentences.zh: 今得材能、資格俱應選者為上，其次，則擇第二任知縣以上有課績者許作郡，初任通判以上許作監司，第二任通判以上許作職司，庶幾人法並用。

translations.literal: Now those meeting both talent and seniority standards should rank first. Next, select those in second term as county magistrate or above with evaluation merit to permit serving as prefect; first term as transit intendant or above to permit serving as circuit supervisor; second term as transit intendant or above to permit serving as commission supervisor -- thus perhaps human talent and law will both be employed.
translations.idiomatic: Now those meeting both talent and seniority standards should rank first. Next, select those in a second term as county magistrate or above with evaluation merit to serve as prefect; those in a first term as transit intendant or above to serve as circuit supervisor; and those in a second term as transit intendant or above to serve as commission supervisor -- thus perhaps human talent and law will both be employed.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " [The court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: " The court assented.

sentences.zh: 寧宗慶元中，重定《武臣關升格》。

translations.literal: During Qingyuan under Emperor Ningzong, the 《Military Officials' Sequential Promotion Standards》 were re-fixed.
translations.idiomatic: During Qingyuan under Emperor Ningzong, the 《Military Officials' Sequential Promotion Standards》 were re-fixed.

sentences.zh: 先是，初改官人必作令，謂之“須入”。

translations.literal: Previously, persons first changing office had to serve as magistrate, called "required county service."
translations.idiomatic: Previously, persons first changing office had to serve as magistrate, called "required county service."

sentences.zh: 至是，復命除殿試上三名、南省元外，並作邑；

translations.literal: From this time, it was again ordered that except for the top three in the palace examination and the provincial first place, all were to serve in counties;
translations.idiomatic: From this time, it was again ordered that except for the top three in the palace examination and the provincial first place, all were to serve in counties;

sentences.zh: 後又命大理評事已改官未曆縣人，並令親民一次，著為令。

translations.literal: Later it was ordered that Grand Court reviewers who had changed office but never served in counties were all to govern people once, established as regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was ordered that Grand Court reviewers who had changed office but never served in counties were all to govern people once, established as regulation.

sentences.zh: 七年，監察御史陳垓建言，乞申戒飭銓法十弊：一曰添差數多，破法耗財；

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Investigating Censor Chen Gai submitted advice, requesting imperial admonition to rectify ten abuses of selection law: first, too many supplementary appointments, breaking law and wasting resources;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Investigating Censor Chen Gai submitted advice, requesting imperial admonition to rectify ten abuses of selection law: first, too many supplementary appointments, breaking law and wasting resources;

sentences.zh: （謂倅貳、幕職、參議、機宜、總戎、鈐轄、監押之類。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, vice prefects, staff posts, advisory officials, expedient officers, overall commanders, seal-holding controllers, supervisory commissioners, and the like.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, vice prefects, staff posts, advisory officials, expedient officers, overall commanders, seal-holding controllers, supervisory commissioners, and the like.)

sentences.zh: 二曰抽差員眾，州縣廢職；

translations.literal: second, numerous requisitioned assignments, prefectures and counties neglecting duties;
translations.idiomatic: second, numerous requisitioned assignments, prefectures and counties neglecting duties;

sentences.zh: （謂監司、帥守幕屬多差見任州縣他官權攝。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, circuit supervisors' and commanders' staff often requisitioned other incumbent prefecture and county officials to serve in temporary acting posts.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, circuit supervisors' and commanders' staff often requisitioned other incumbent prefecture and county officials to serve in temporary acting posts.)

sentences.zh: 三曰攝局違法，蠹政害民；

translations.literal: third, illegal acting posts, corrupting administration and harming the people;
translations.idiomatic: third, illegal acting posts, corrupting administration and harming the people;

sentences.zh: （謂監司、師守徇私差權幕屬等職。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, circuit supervisors and commanders privately favor appointing provisional staff and similar posts.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, circuit supervisors and commanders privately favor appointing provisional staff and similar posts.)

sentences.zh: 四曰“須入”不行，僥幸撓法；

translations.literal: fourth, "required county service" not enforced, opportunistically circumventing law;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, "required county service" not enforced, opportunistically circumventing law;

sentences.zh: （謂初改官人必作知縣，今多規免，苟圖京局，躐求倅貳，遂使不曾曆縣之人冒當郡寄。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, persons first changing office must serve as county magistrate, but today many plot exemption, grasp at capital posts, overreach for vice prefect posts, so that persons who never served in counties presumptuously hold prefectural trust.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, persons first changing office must serve as county magistrate, but today many plot exemption, grasp at capital posts, overreach for vice prefect posts, so that persons who never served in counties presumptuously hold prefectural trust.)

sentences.zh: 五曰奏辟不應，奔競日甚；

translations.literal: fifth, improper memorial appointments, unscrupulous competition growing daily;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, improper memorial appointments, unscrupulous competition growing daily;

sentences.zh: （謂在法未經任人不許奏辟，今或以初任或以闕次遠而改辟見次者。）〉

translations.literal: (That is, by law persons not yet having served in a post were not permitted memorial appointment; today some with first office or distant vacancy sequence change to appoint those at current sequence.)
translations.idiomatic: (That is, by law persons not yet having served in a post were not permitted memorial appointment; today some with first office or distant vacancy sequence change to appoint those at current sequence.)

sentences.zh: 六曰改任巧捷，紊亂官常；

translations.literal: sixth, clever manipulation of transferred appointments, disordering regular official duties;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, clever manipulation of transferred appointments, disordering regular official duties;

sentences.zh: （謂在法已授差遣人，不得幹求換易。

translations.literal: (That is, by law one already granted assignment dispatch may not importune to exchange.
translations.idiomatic: (That is, by law one already granted assignment dispatch may not importune to exchange.

sentences.zh: 今既授是官，復謀他職，辭卑居尊，棄彼就此。）〉

translations.literal: Today once granted that office, they again scheme for other posts, refusing the humble and seeking the honored, abandoning that for this.)
translations.idiomatic: Today once granted that office, they again scheme for other posts, refusing the humble and seeking the honored, abandoning that for this.)

sentences.zh: 七曰薦舉不公，多歸請托；

translations.literal: seventh, unfair recommendations, mostly yielding to solicitations;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, unfair recommendations, mostly yielding to solicitations;

sentences.zh: 八曰借補繁多，官資泛濫；

translations.literal: eighth, numerous borrowed provisional appointments, official ranks flooding the system;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, numerous borrowed provisional appointments, official ranks flooding the system;

sentences.zh: 九曰瘝曠職守，役心外求；

translations.literal: ninth, absentee dereliction of duty, hearts set on external seeking;
translations.idiomatic: ninth, absentee dereliction of duty, hearts set on external seeking;

sentences.zh: 十曰匿過居官，玩視國法。

translations.literal: tenth, concealing faults while holding office, treating state law lightly.
translations.idiomatic: tenth, concealing faults while holding office, treating state law lightly.

sentences.zh: （謂曾經罪犯，必俟赦宥。

translations.literal: (That is, those who had committed offenses must wait for pardon and amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: (That is, those who had committed offenses must wait for pardon and amnesty.

sentences.zh: 今則既遭彈劾，初未經赦者，經營差遣。）〉

translations.literal: Today once impeached, even before amnesty, they maneuver for assignment dispatch.)
translations.idiomatic: Today once impeached, even before amnesty, they maneuver for assignment dispatch.)

sentences.zh: 舊制，軍功補授之人，自合從軍，非老疾當汰，無參部及就辟之法。

translations.literal: Under the old system, persons supplementarily appointed for military merit should have followed the army; only if aged or ill were they to be eliminated -- there was no method of assembling at the ministry or seeking appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, persons supplementarily appointed for military merit should have followed the army. Only if aged or ill were they to be eliminated -- there was no method of assembling at the ministry or seeking appointment.

sentences.zh: 比年諸路奏功不實，寅緣竄名，許令到部，及諸司紛然奏辟，實礙銓法。

translations.literal: In recent years the various circuits reported merit falsely; through connections they inserted names, were permitted to come to the ministry, and the various offices clamored to memorial-appoint -- truly obstructing selection law.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the various circuits reported merit falsely. Through connections they inserted names, were permitted to come to the ministry, and the various offices clamored to memorial-appoint -- truly obstructing selection law.

sentences.zh: 建炎兵興，雜流補授者眾，有曰上書獻策，曰勤王，曰守禦，曰捕盜，曰奉使，其名不一，皆閫帥假便宜承製之權以擅除擢。

translations.literal: When the Jianyan military crisis arose, numerous persons of mixed streams received supplementary appointment -- some called 'submitting books and offering strategies,' 'diligently serving the throne,' 'defending borders,' 'capturing bandits,' 'bearing imperial missions' -- names not uniform -- all military commissioners used provisional imperial dispatch authority to appoint and promote at will.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jianyan military crisis arose, numerous persons of mixed streams received supplementary appointment -- some called 'submitting books and offering strategies,' 'diligently serving the throne,' 'defending borders,' 'capturing bandits,' 'bearing imperial missions' -- names not uniform. All military commissioners used provisional imperial dispatch authority to appoint and promote at will.

sentences.zh: 有進士徑補京官者，有素身冒名即為郎、大夫者。

translations.literal: Some degree holders were directly supplemented to capital official rank; some unknown persons falsely assumed names and immediately became bureau directors or grand masters.
translations.idiomatic: Some degree holders were directly supplemented to capital official rank; some unknown persons falsely assumed names and immediately became bureau directors or grand masters.

sentences.zh: 乃詔：“從軍應賞者，第補右選，以清流品。

translations.literal: An edict was then issued: "Those who should be rewarded for military service are to be ranked for supplementation in the Right Selection, with pure-stream grades.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued: "Those due reward for military service are to be ranked for supplementation through the Right Selection, with pure-stream grades.

sentences.zh: ”又有民間願習射者，籍其姓名。

translations.literal: " Moreover, among the people there were those willing to practice archery; their names were registered.
translations.idiomatic: " Moreover, civilians who wished to practice archery had their names registered.

sentences.zh: 守令月一試，取藝優者，如三路保甲法區用。

translations.literal: Prefects and magistrates tested them once a month, selecting those superior in skill for use in the Three-Circuit baojia defense districts.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and magistrates tested them monthly and selected the most skilled for use in the Three-Circuit baojia defense districts.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，嚐以兵革經用不足，有司請募民入貲補官，帝難之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaoxing, because military expenses were insufficient from repeated campaigns, responsible offices requested recruiting the people to enter funds and receive office supplementation; the Emperor found it difficult to accept.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shaoxing, repeated warfare had left military funds short, and responsible offices proposed recruiting civilians to purchase office by contributing funds; the Emperor was reluctant.

sentences.zh: 參知政事張守曰：“祖宗時，授以齋郎，今之將仕郎是也。

translations.literal: Participating Administrator Zhang Shou said: "In the time of the ancestors, they were granted Acolyte of the Temple, which is today's Gentleman for Initial Service.
translations.idiomatic: Participating Administrator Zhang Shou said: "Under the founding emperors, such men were granted Acolyte of the Temple—the equivalent of today's Gentleman for Initial Service.

sentences.zh: ”知樞密院李回曰：“此猶愈科率於民。

translations.literal: " Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Hui said: "This is still better than levying exactions on the people.
translations.idiomatic: " Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Li Hui said: "This is still preferable to levying exactions on the people.

sentences.zh: ”乃許補承節郎、承信郎、諸州文學至進義副尉六等，後又給通直郎、修武郎、秉義郎、承直至迪功郎。

translations.literal: " They then permitted supplementation to six grades from Gentleman for Upholding Integrity and Gentleman for Upholding Trust through Literary Scholar of Various Prefectures down to Deputy Vice Commander for Advancing Righteousness; later they also granted Gentleman for Unimpeded Service, Gentleman for Cultivating Military Affairs, Gentleman for Upholding Righteousness, Gentleman for Upholding Integrity through Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.
translations.idiomatic: " They then permitted supplementation to six grades from Gentleman for Upholding Integrity and Gentleman for Upholding Trust through Literary Scholar of Various Prefectures down to Deputy Vice Commander for Advancing Righteousness; later they extended the range to Gentleman for Unimpeded Service, Gentleman for Cultivating Military Affairs, Gentleman for Upholding Righteousness, and from Gentleman for Upholding Integrity through Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.

sentences.zh: 其注擬、資考、磨勘、改轉、蔭補、封敘，並依奏補出身法，毋得注令錄及親民官。

translations.literal: Their assignment, seniority appraisal, merit review, transfer, yin supplementation, and enfeoffment and posthumous honors all followed the law for memorial-supplemented entry; they could not be assigned as magistrates, recorders, or people-governing officials.
translations.idiomatic: Their assignment, seniority appraisal, merit review, transfer, yin supplementation, and enfeoffment and posthumous honors all followed the law governing memorial-supplemented entry; they could not be assigned as magistrates, recording secretaries, or people-governing officials.

sentences.zh: 和議之後，立格購求遺書，亦命以官。

translations.literal: After the peace agreement, standards were established to purchase lost books, and office was also granted for this.
translations.idiomatic: After the peace agreement, regulations were established to purchase lost books, and office was also granted as reward.

sentences.zh: 凡歿於王事，無遺表致仕格法者，聽奏補本宗異姓親子孫弟侄，文臣將仕郎，武臣承信郎；

translations.literal: For all who died in royal service without a final memorial or retirement under standard law, memorial supplementation was permitted for sons, grandsons, younger brothers, and nephews of the same surname in the patriline, civil officials to Gentleman for Initial Service, military officials to Gentleman for Upholding Trust;
translations.idiomatic: For all who died in royal service without a final memorial or retirement under standard law, memorial supplementation was permitted for sons, grandsons, younger brothers, and nephews of the same surname in the patriline—civil officials to Gentleman for Initial Service, military officials to Gentleman for Upholding Trust;

sentences.zh: 餘親，上州文學或進武校尉，所以褒恤忠義也。

translations.literal: other kin to Literary Scholar of Upper Prefecture or Vice Commander for Advancing Military Affairs—thus loyalty and righteousness were praised and comforted.
translations.idiomatic: other kin to Literary Scholar of Upper Prefecture or Vice Commander for Advancing Military Affairs—thus loyalty and righteousness were honored and comforted.

sentences.zh: 又以兩淮、荊襄，其土廣袤，募民力田。

translations.literal: Moreover, because the Huai region and Jing-Xiang lands were broad and vast, the people were recruited to work the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, because the Huai region and Jing-Xiang lands were broad and vast, civilians were recruited to cultivate the fields.

sentences.zh: 凡白身勸民墾田及七十五頃者與副尉，五百頃補承信郎。

translations.literal: For all commoners who encouraged the people to open fields reaching seventy-five qing, they received Deputy Vice Magistrate; at five hundred qing they were supplemented to Gentleman for Upholding Trust.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners who encouraged others to open fields totaling seventy-five qing received appointment as deputy vice magistrate; at five hundred qing they were supplemented to Gentleman for Upholding Trust.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，命帥臣、監司、郡守、嚐任兩府及朝官等遣親屬進貢，等第補授登仕郎、將仕郎，推恩理為選限。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong took the throne, he ordered commanders, circuit supervisors, prefects, those who had served in the two administrations and capital officials, and the like to send kinsmen to present tribute; by grade they were supplemented and appointed as Gentleman for Entering Office or Gentleman for Initial Service, with extended grace counted toward selection waiting limits.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong took the throne, he ordered commanders, circuit supervisors, prefects, former two-administration officials, and capital officials to send kinsmen to present tribute; by grade they received appointment as Gentleman for Entering Office or Gentleman for Initial Service, with extended grace counted toward selection waiting limits.

sentences.zh: 淳熙三年，詔罷鬻爵，除歉歲民願入粟賑饑、有裕於眾，聽補官，餘皆停。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunxi, an edict abolished the sale of ranks; except in famine years when the people wished to contribute grain to relieve hunger and there was surplus for the multitude, office supplementation was permitted—all else was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chunxi, an edict abolished the sale of ranks; except in famine years when civilians wished to contribute grain to relieve hunger to the benefit of the community, office supplementation was permitted—all else was stopped.

sentences.zh: 自是，進納軍功，不理選限，登仕郎、諸州助教不許出官，止於贖罪及就轉運司請解而已。

translations.literal: From this time, purchase entry and military merit were not subject to selection waiting limits; Gentleman for Entering Office and Assistant Instructor of Various Prefectures were not permitted to take office outside, limited only to redeeming offenses and requesting release at the transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: From this time, purchase entry and military merit were not subject to selection waiting limits; Gentlemen for Entering Office and Assistant Instructors of Various Prefectures were not permitted to take substantive posts, being limited to redeeming offenses and requesting release at the transport commission.
